Updated tool descriptions to guide models toward appropriate timeout budgets, while preserving `-1` for indefinite waits and `BACKGROUND` processes.

c7445e24582aabfa1c2f45c2108982511769385a.title: Remove HY3 from Freebuff free tier
c7445e24582aabfa1c2f45c2108982511769385a.summary: HY3 models removed from free tier. Direct API access blocked. Paid/BYOK routing unaffected.

7baf11ac08f12726408167fd391367d461a96249.title: Refactor test scripts to isolate integration tests
7baf11ac08f12726408167fd391367d461a96249.summary: Updated `test` scripts in CLI, Shared/Core, Agent Runtime, and SDK packages to exclude `*.integration.test.ts` files. Added `test:files` and `test:files:integration` helper scripts to dynamically discover and sort unit and integration test files.

dd1e2cfc9f90b5c1b0c2e056e7eecf45ae0c7cd5.title: CLI state stores enable immer MapSet independently
dd1e2cfc9f90b5c1b0c2e056e7eecf45ae0c7cd5.summary: Moved `enableMapSet()` from `init-app` to individual state stores (`chat-store`, `feedback-store`, `message-block-store`, `publish-store`). Ensures Map/Set support is active on import, fixing initialization order bugs.

f28ecce37f526a75beecd2e0c8d82da50630abba.title: Removed MiMo 2.5 Pro and CrofAI GLM 5.2 free agents
f28ecce37f526a75beecd2e0c8d82da50630abba.summary: Deleted `base2-free-mimo-pro` and `code-reviewer-mimo-pro` agents due to low usage. Removed `base2-free-glm-crof` to fix referral exploit where hand-written API calls bypassed GLM 5.2 referral requirements. Free mode now enforces single model ID per entitlement-gated model.

a47be121a650358f747794cf743870e75d35e6b3.title: Fix test suite hangs from browser-use and librarian scripts
a47be121a650358f747794cf743870e75d35e6b3.summary: Renamed `browser-use.test.ts` and `librarian.test.ts` to `run-*.ts`. Prevents `bun test` from crashing due to missing API keys or module-scope exits.

2e0d17a8eb3b3bf8b25564ff44b3338348cbfc63.title: Add Web onboarding, tour, and gate redirect analytics events
2e0d17a8eb3b3bf8b25564ff44b3338348cbfc63.summary: Added new analytics events to track user interactions with the Freebuff Web creation gate, first-session onboarding, and workspace spotlight tour. These events capture specific steps, completion states, and redirect clicks to help analyze funnel drop-off and user behavior.

60dd01fe109f976b0e1e7eea23b9bd0e3ba67b6e.title: Limited-tier users can redeem GLM 5.2 via bounty grants
60dd01fe109f976b0e1e7eea23b9bd0e3ba67b6e.summary: Removed hard tier gate for GLM 5.2 in limited access regions. GLM is now allowed if the user has bounty-earned sessions, changing referral banner logic to show unlocked state based on session balance rather than tier.

4f9fad7460a17948620ee4c82d02a3ddb4bba868.title: Add takeover instance header for session slots
4f9fad7460a17948620ee4c82d02a3ddb4bba868.summary: Introduced `FREEBUFF_TAKEOVER_INSTANCE_HEADER` to allow users to force-release a session slot held by an unreachable instance. The server validates the instance ID against the current holder to prevent stale takeover requests.

9bf66ff09f2303f7bc13ebb134678c45869f2e30.title: CLI shows 'high demand' status during free-mode capacity deferrals
9bf66ff09f2303f7bc13ebb134678c45869f2e30.summary: The CLI now detects server-side capacity deferrals for free-tier users under peak load. Instead of a generic 'retrying' message, the status bar displays 'high demand — in line, starting soon...' to clarify wait times. This change adds a new listener hook to the SDK to propagate these specific 429 errors to the UI.

e4a3a7abe1a6db3cdb1a3ff7ad5bae9737e48fa3.title: Added session drain window
e4a3a7abe1a6db3cdb1a3ff7ad5bae9737e48fa3.summary: Defined `FREEBUFF_SESSION_GRACE_MS` constant. Allows in-flight agent runs to complete after session expiry, preventing premature termination.

383fb0ceededb4056d40b1f6db984a321b7feb21.title: Fix streak display collision and font rendering
383fb0ceededb4056d40b1f6db984a321b7feb21.summary: CLI landing screen now prevents streak text from colliding with the heading on narrow terminals and uses universal bullet glyphs instead of unsupported circles. Streak layout logic moved to shared core for consistent rendering.

9c3d9f0caebc6cd1ad214b92a7440fd0ff1cf929.title: Version bump to 0.0.138
9c3d9f0caebc6cd1ad214b92a7440fd0ff1cf929.summary: Release package version updated from 0.0.137 to 0.0.138.

037b51122b8b627807b9f138f7fffa16b0a6fe65.title: Add analytics event for desktop download clicks
037b51122b8b627807b9f138f7fffa16b0a6fe65.summary: New `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_DOWNLOAD_CLICKED` enum added to track user clicks on desktop download CTAs across home, products, and desktop pages. Includes `location`, `platform`, and `repeat` properties for detailed funnel analysis.

04d4379f1617e48948e10d522ee2688dd9b84942.title: Fix nested .gitignore ignore patterns
04d4379f1617e48948e10d522ee2688dd9b84942.summary: Replaced manual gitignore pattern rebasing with native scoped ignore chain testing. Fixes incorrect file exclusion in nested directories.

4d3c46a551d4e0e3f37e902090ea267ec9b9ab5e.title: Update disposable email blocklist with behavioral evidence
4d3c46a551d4e0e3f37e902090ea267ec9b9ab5e.summary: Added proxyvpn.cn, impact.qd.je, and fincy.qd.je to disposable email domains based on account activity patterns. Excluded dns-proxy.com and proximus.lu due to lack of evidence or legitimate ISP status.

81bb087616c1eebb0516d8c74562cd6c4cd3cdbf.title: Block 37 disposable email domains
81bb087616c1eebb0516d8c74562cd6c4cd3cdbf.summary: Added 37 domains to `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` in `common/src/util/disposable-email.ts`. List compiled from prod data: >=20 accounts and >=75% ban rate. Targets Gmail lookalikes and single-day bursts.

32b7907dfe18e9fd79fac194172c07fcc816edda.title: Fix terminal command cleanup and broker startup
32b7907dfe18e9fd79fac194172c07fcc816edda.summary: Terminal commands no longer hang on exit due to background descendants. Broker startup failures now show clear recovery steps, including Windows Terminal guidance. Process group cleanup is now bounded to prevent infinite waits.

af3257b3b7d7a81bde74a67d84d9a683478b684d.title: Add desktop.failed_turn_recovery analytics event
af3257b3b7d7a81bde74a67d84d9a683478b684d.summary: New constant `DESKTOP_FAILED_TURN_RECOVERY` added to `AnalyticsEvent` enum. Event whitelisted in `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` to ensure reliable measurement of recovery funnels.

12660b067482362d977d9d423b6a2c107ad0c76c.title: Auto-retry for silent reasoning-only stops
12660b067482362d977d9d423b6a2c107ad0c76c.summary: The agent now detects when a model ends with only reasoning and no answer, even on a normal stop. It automatically retries these steps instead of silently failing, treating them like output limit interruptions.

542451446bb2086182f9a10dfd9dc56cece4c133.title: Support abortSignal in promptAiSdkStream
542451446bb2086182f9a10dfd9dc56cece4c133.summary: Added abortSignal to streamText call in promptAiSdkStream, enabling cancellation via params.signal.

eeb5209f0d72ca408c7decfcbac295cf21d06cea.title: Update free-fable agent reviewer config
eeb5209f0d72ca408c7decfcbac295cf21d06cea.summary: Base2 free-fable agent now uses Fable for its reviewer. Cross-model subagent fallbacks removed.

d1c94381b39773dbd68e9c7ebbd4909724179110.title: Terminal command broker isolates CLI subprocesses
d1c94381b39773dbd68e9c7ebbd4909724179110.summary: New `terminal-command-broker` and `entry.ts` isolate terminal protocols during subprocess execution. This prevents mouse/focus report leakage into CLI output and stabilizes Windows `winpty` interactions. Includes new Windows smoke tests and renames isolation utilities.

f56844fd118df56422c40c55968c247d6253c562.title: Windows terminal commands no longer garble Freebuff UI
f56844fd118df56422c40c55968c247d6253c562.summary: Added a Windows-specific guard that temporarily disables terminal mouse and focus reporting while shell commands run. This prevents console-attached child processes from painting raw escape sequences over the interface. Focus reporting and mouse support are automatically restored once the command process tree exits.

32405d54b26ef83e80be7c091a8c9610c6bf3b8a.title: CLI: New terminal protocol controller and smoke test
32405d54b26ef83e80be7c091a8c9610c6bf3b8a.summary: Added `terminal-protocol-controller.ts` and `terminal-command-isolation.ts` to manage terminal state during command execution. Introduced `smoke-terminal-isolation-windows.ts` to verify focus and mouse report isolation on Windows. Removed legacy `windows-terminal-command-guard.ts`.

0251dddf1475cf3bd2449b2fe3f4cb429903459d.title: Fix timeout error blame
0251dddf1475cf3bd2449b2fe3f4cb429903459d.summary: Updated `FETCH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_USER_MESSAGE` to stop blaming user network. Now acknowledges slow model starts as potential cause.

5423683dc8558497f5168a3e65a61e9a5e01e0ad.title: Fix Fable code review 403, drop thinker-gpt
5423683dc8558497f5168a3e65a61e9a5e01e0ad.summary: Added `code-reviewer-fable` to fix missing code review for Fable sessions. Removed `thinker-gpt` escalation from `base2-free-fable` to prevent wasted spawn attempts.

cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.title: Removed ChatGPT OAuth Connect Command
cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.summary: Removed the `/connect` command and associated ChatGPT OAuth components from the CLI and SDK. The `/plan` and `/review` commands no longer delegate to GPT models via OAuth, running on the selected model instead. `thinker-gpt` agent spawning logic updated.

8c9929fa0f77987bcfd64f0625b68a97cf9dc17b.title: Fix self-update test archive extraction on Windows
8c9929fa0f77987bcfd64f0625b68a97cf9dc17b.summary: Updated CLI self-update test script to explicitly invoke Windows native `bsdtar` instead of relying on PATH. Prevents Git Bash's GNU tar from misinterpreting Windows paths during archive extraction.

cfefab1485351974f3ed0461c9d4797fbb251c9d.title: Fix CLI update loop and improve version comparison
cfefab1485351974f3ed0461c9d4797fbb251c9d.summary: Updated launcher to strictly validate semver and repair stale cached binaries synchronously when wrapper versions mismatch. This prevents the CLI from getting stuck in update loops or failing to launch due to corrupted version metadata.

17d6db8ba087352b631923ba3e14852fcbc18b9d.title: Add self-update integration test script, bump version to 0.0.137
17d6db8ba087352b631923ba3e14852fcbc18b9d.summary: New script `cli/scripts/test-published-self-update.ts` verifies CLI self-update flow across platforms. Release version bumped to 0.0.137.

7335066f45ad29fa39ad3f09fa84c45ab1aca737.title: Chat agent defaults to DeepSeek direct model ID
7335066f45ad29fa39ad3f09fa84c45ab1aca737.summary: The base-chat agent now uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` instead of the Fireworks-specific ID. The legacy Fireworks model ID is marked as deprecated for new code, though it remains accepted for backward compatibility.

817391fb58001b3bc24fbc42be479676d265d7d0.title: Fix subagent context inheritance for spawn tools
817391fb58001b3bc24fbc42be479676d265d7d0.summary: Subagents spawned via `spawn_agents` or `spawn_agent_inline` now receive an accurate transcript, including assistant messages generated before the spawn call. Legacy `SUBAGENT_SPAWN` announcements are stripped from inherited history to prevent provider errors.

a0d5b7f05d51dd5c0638193e6bff94151af278ee.title: Block new disposable email domains
a0d5b7f05d51dd5c0638193e6bff94151af278ee.summary: Added `l0veyou.com`, `pumpkinai.space`, and `pumpkinai.it.com` to the disposable email blocklist. Prevents abuse from accounts using these catch-all domains.

59b71a2329ee96e2378ae589e09694cfa02eee4a.title: Remove stepPrompt, fix GPT-5.6 cache
59b71a2329ee96e2378ae589e09694cfa02eee4a.summary: Removed `stepPrompt` from agents. Deleted `ephemeralTrailingMessageBreaksCache`. Updated `base2` instructions.

8f24a429cd6addf8fb858155634ef5241fea86b4.title: Context-pruner budget raised to 400k
8f24a429cd6addf8fb858155634ef5241fea86b4.summary: Default context-pruner max length increased from 200k to 400k. Models with smaller context windows (Kimi, Tencent, Ling) explicitly capped at 250k via new `contextPrunerBudgetForModel` helper.

e183deaed6c794aacff15662a87d41c98e3201d1.title: Add session heartbeat constants for multi-session liveness
e183deaed6c794aacff15662a87d41c98e3201d1.summary: Introduced `FREEBUFF_HEARTBEAT_HEADER` and `FREEBUFF_SESSION_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS` to support per-tab liveness tracking in multi-session mode. This ensures active sessions retain concurrency slots while preventing premature drops during brief network interruptions.

cc568bb92ddf1d15ac7be8b35e078a80670a6563.title: Fix GPT-5.6-Luna context window size
cc568bb92ddf1d15ac7be8b35e078a80670a6563.summary: Corrected context window for `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` to 1,000,000 tokens in both `agents/base-chat.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Prevents premature summarization and prompt cache invalidation by ensuring the 0.4 budget calculation yields 400k instead of 52k.

2ae66743c3896cfb8f44812cf9643807c513fd59.title: Add testing docs: machine-global state, polling budgets
2ae66743c3896cfb8f44812cf9643807c513fd59.summary: New section in `docs/testing.md` covers machine-global state (e.g. process tables) requiring atomic locks, and polling helpers whose deadlines must be shorter than test budgets to avoid unattributable failures. Introduces `test/support/budgets.ts` pattern.

115d80be38b93542912a3bb3cb0ed85f67f48290.title: Clarify CI flake policy: unit suites fail on retry, integration warn
115d80be38b93542912a3bb3cb0ed85f67f48290.summary: Updated `docs/testing.md` to reflect new CI behavior: unit suites now fail on retry (based on 100-run analysis showing zero rescues), while integration suites retain `Flaky suite` warnings. Added explanation that CI retries do not mask contention-based flakes, as each package runs on its own runner.

13b1cfee56ea86d90e68a05afbb0399cc5c062a5.title: GPT-5.6 prompt cache fix
13b1cfee56ea86d90e68a05afbb0399cc5c062a5.summary: Fixed prompt cache breakage for GPT-5.6 by making step prompts resident. Prevents token loss when trailing messages are pruned.

612e2a39e0355c12169f3dd37ce5e3bf09942e02.title: Add shared thread title util
612e2a39e0355c12169f3dd37ce5e3bf09942e02.summary: New `common/src/util/thread-title.ts` file. Provides shared constants, prompts, and sanitizer for generating chat thread titles. Dependency-free for reuse across desktop and web.

ae8c38c6a145ee540ec48aea9027714917d9da36.title: Add freebuff offer-gate invariant tests
ae8c38c6a145ee540ec48aea9027714917d9da36.summary: New common testing utility `freebuff-offer-invariants.ts` validates that offered model IDs match session admission, resolvers, validators, and free-mode agent allowlists. CLI model selector exports `freebuffCliOfferedModelIds` to enable this check, ensuring earned models like GLM 5.2 are not offered if gates reject them.

3a7b54b212bfe45eafb19525bbf52041f9b3a6c9.title: Tmux CLI and Cloud Build switch to DeepSeek V4 Flash
3a7b54b212bfe45eafb19525bbf52041f9b3a6c9.summary: The Tmux CLI agent and cloud build process now use DeepSeek V4 Flash instead of MiniMax M3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro respectively. This aligns terminal operations with the root session model and reduces costs for build-heavy tasks.

ef5190fe8024ca729df82dfa11c847354a3ca279.title: Fix Defender false positives on Windows
ef5190fe8024ca729df82dfa11c847354a3ca279.summary: Removed PowerShell probes for AVX2 detection and terminal theme to prevent Windows Defender from flagging CLI as malware. Added `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` env var to suppress terminal reset watchdog on locked-down systems.

3e5be71544b2879899a0dea5162bf6f7e8195bcb.title: Added limited-trial section to model selector
3e5be71544b2879899a0dea5162bf6f7e8195bcb.summary: The model picker now displays a "LIMITED TRIAL" section for capacity-limited models advertised by the server. This section shows remaining pool capacity and user-specific reset countdowns, appearing in both collapsed and expanded views. A new `base2-free-fable.ts` agent definition supports this offer.

6e1168a960e83d3c2651c6765b504f45f0d091b9.title: Cloud planner moves to DeepSeek V4 Flash for all tiers
6e1168a960e83d3c2651c6765b504f45f0d091b9.summary: The cloud planner now uses DeepSeek V4 Flash for both full-access and limited tiers, replacing MiniMax M3 for full access. This unifies the planner model selection, simplifying routing logic while maintaining access for limited regions.

f388f14e2b1dcafb2a95799598ceb7e7ac511c24.title: Remove focus cue, restrict 'Images' badge to multimodal models
f388f14e2b1dcafb2a95799598ceb7e7ac511c24.summary: Removed the redundant 'Press Enter' cue from the model selector to reduce card width. The 'Images' badge now appears only for natively multimodal models, preventing misleading labels on text-only models.

062743b69a890d6f0e6efba5b3806cd8f6cad036.title: Show 'Images' tag for all models in selector
062743b69a890d6f0e6efba5b3806cd8f6cad036.summary: Model selector now displays "· Images" for every model. Text-only models also accept images via server-side description. Ensures consistent UI labeling.

a5cb80f3d735b96b63f2fc075689ab4ed9955056.title: Steer off superseded models on every session start
a5cb80f3d735b96b63f2fc075689ab4ed9955056.summary: Model preference migration now runs on every load instead of once. MiMo 2.5 marked superseded by DeepSeek V4 Flash. Saved picks for stale models reset to Flash on new sessions.

31ac8a0f82d45b3a6f82a46a9be1a4c6b8ad3b11.title: Add IP cap status and enforce canonical system prompt openings
31ac8a0f82d45b3a6f82a46a9be1a4c6b8ad3b11.summary: CLI now handles `ip_capped` status, showing a specific retry message when too many users share an IP. Core adds strict prefix validation for freebuff root system prompts to prevent identity bypasses.

ef75fd7a27e09c75d822efcfdaa28b023a03e31f.title: Hide pre-milestone streak notes. Reorder models.
ef75fd7a27e09c75d822efcfdaa28b023a03e31f.summary: Landing screen no longer shows streak bonus countdowns before earning a full week. DeepSeek and MiniMax model list order changed.

d5ca1376e2a658169fc355905b29159d5af6a85a.title: CLI: NEW badge, supersession nudge, auto-migrate old model picks
d5ca1376e2a658169fc355905b29159d5af6a85a.summary: Model picker shows 'NEW' badge on freshly released models and gates supersession nudge to selected row only. Saved preferences auto-migrate from superseded models (DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiniMax M3) to replacements once per migration id.

fe2f293cfec04f7effa3601e4719d8d5583b81a2.title: Fix Windows terminal command guidance in system prompt
fe2f293cfec04f7effa3601e4719d8d5583b81a2.summary: Updated system prompt to instruct agent to use POSIX commands (`ls`, `mv`, `rm`, `grep`) instead of Windows CMD/PowerShell commands on Windows. Clarified that bash is used on Windows, requiring forward slashes in paths.

f3e3cce8abe081a471cdf9fbd525426f7fba600f.title: Fix model selector focus, layout, and limited access handling
f3e3cce8abe081a471cdf9fbd525426f7fba600f.summary: Recommended model now stays focused when expanding list. Fixed layout clipping when access tier changes asynchronously. Limited access mode keeps standalone recommendation.

d248ecc5ad5aafd3b80a52ed21c4244e0aa849d6.title: Fix: Skill metadata accepts nested values, long descriptions clamp
d248ecc5ad5aafd3b80a52ed21c4244e0aa849d6.summary: Updated `SkillMetadataSchema` to allow `unknown` values instead of strict strings, preventing rejection of skills with nested metadata blocks. Modified `description` validation to truncate over-long strings to the max length rather than failing validation.

5d8bc0232add269427599ffd4f928ee6a4786f52.title: Fix referral GLM selection & cache handling in CLI
5d8bc0232add269427599ffd4f928ee6a4786f52.summary: Referral GLM model now correctly persists selection and avoids invalid fallbacks during transient errors. Referral cache is scoped by access tier and cleared on session end to prevent stale data leakage. Model preference saving ignores non-standard IDs.

b1f68e07ef57b84fe337023718d350a96ec2305b.title: Remove Kimi model from Freebuff free mode
b1f68e07ef57b84fe337023718d350a96ec2305b.summary: Kimi K2.7 Code removed from free mode and CLI picker. Old CLI builds using Kimi now 403 with 'free_mode_invalid_agent_model'. Paid/BYOK Kimi unaffected.

0cda526a6c5bbf6cab64dafb874a9774ac1a4299.title: Fix Windows path pruning and warn on glob file limit
0cda526a6c5bbf6cab64dafb874a9774ac1a4299.summary: Normalized paths to POSIX format to ensure `.gitignore` rules correctly prune nested directories on Windows. The glob tool now explicitly warns users when search results are incomplete due to hitting the 10,000 file scan limit.

ab4919394f7cd07cc1f360e48f04b600a1f6d40a.title: CLI: Honor explicit model switch by ending locked session
ab4919394f7cd07cc1f360e48f04b600a1f6d40a.summary: When a user deliberately picks a new model while locked on another, the CLI now ends the previous session and re-claims on the requested model. Background rejoins still revert silently. If ending fails, a system message explains the issue.

7c831448a6e554c45b87894487ebe7421385045f.title: Windows bash detection: WSL removed, per-user Git found
7c831448a6e554c45b87894487ebe7421385045f.summary: Windows bash lookup now rejects WSL paths and finds bash.exe beside git.exe for per-user installs. Error message updated to two options.

254c227edee9d656de7fc74312468062e17f7a1e.title: CLI: Explain model_locked rejections in chat
254c227edee9d656de7fc74312468062e17f7a1e.summary: Added explicit user pick tracking to `use-freebuff-session.ts`. When a deliberate model switch is rejected due to an active session, the CLI now displays a system message explaining the conflict and instructing the user to run `/end-session` first, replacing the previous silent revert behavior.

6cc0c94c19331c4a4009587d3b698916f00f9f0a.title: Remove unused referral tier ladder and perks
6cc0c94c19331c4a4009587d3b698916f00f9f0a.summary: Deleted web referral tier ladder, watermark removal perks, and related helpers. Referral rewards now strictly defined as daily session bonuses.

9f80be02582ab23c45aa4fd7adf8370b2613ad92.title: Remove Kimi from free model picker
9f80be02582ab23c45aa4fd7adf8370b2613ad92.summary: Removed Kimi K2.7 Code from the selectable model list due to cost. Updated CLI and documentation to reflect supported open-source models.

c22abe9a8900d52fac3c91bd1d12f407e631be0c.title: Luna price ceiling raised to 0.5/3.0
c22abe9a8900d52fac3c91bd1d12f407e631be0c.summary: Luna's `provider.max_price` raised from 0.1/0.6 to 0.5/3.0. Prevents OpenRouter strict-comparison 404s while still blocking expensive Azure/Bedrock endpoints.

bfead8065f4f0e68f6247fa51973c73185d00525.title: Added GPT-5.6 Luna model support with dedicated agents
bfead8065f4f0e68f6247fa51973c73185d00525.summary: Added GPT-5.6 Luna as a supported free model, including new base2 and code-reviewer agent definitions. Enforced server-side routing pinning to OpenAI and high reasoning effort to prevent cost spikes and ensure quality.

1ba142d747a1c095f2be79abe6b6adefad0c2a28.title: Desktop unlimited sessions cap raised to 3
1ba142d747a1c095f2be79abe6b6adefad0c2a28.summary: Users on the full tier can now run up to three concurrent unlimited-model sessions (DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5) in Freebuff Desktop. Premium bucket remains limited to one active session. Session count data is now exposed in API responses.

5b8b58dbe1bc8498ac86a6e8aaa8e6311e86331f.title: GLM 5.2 referral cap removed; legacy route retired
5b8b58dbe1bc8498ac86a6e8aaa8e6311e86331f.summary: GLM 5.2 referral rewards are now uncapped per qualified referral. The legacy CrofAI GLM 5.2 premium route is removed from the model picker, making the referral route the only way to access the model.

f5526661a4291076b5784de328a4ddb405831935.title: GLM 5.2 referral sessions now reset daily
f5526661a4291076b5784de328a4ddb405831935.summary: Referral rewards and streak bonuses for GLM 5.2 now reset daily (Pacific) instead of weekly. Provider switched to CrofAI for lower cost. UI updated to reflect daily limits.

159673adf8f8dd060344460862f309b21986134f.title: MiMo and MiniMax model taglines updated
159673adf8f8dd060344460862f309b21986134f.summary: Updated marketing taglines for MiMo 2.5 Pro, MiMo 2.5, and MiniMax M3.

faee98a2042d0b024219330c1f6ae2f6df89cff0.title: Model selector shows '· Images' suffix for multimodal models
faee98a2042d0b024219330c1f6ae2f6df89cff0.summary: Multimodal models now display a compact ' · Images' indicator appended to their tagline in the CLI selector. This prevents the image capability note from wrapping onto a separate line.

ff0629f1f1b73fec52d0107117f3c27cc46c389f.title: SDK: optional precomputed projectIndex skips tree-sitter parse
ff0629f1f1b73fec52d0107117f3c27cc46c389f.summary: Adds `computeProjectIndexFromFiles` export and `projectIndex` option to `run`, `initialSessionState`, and `applyOverridesToSessionState`. Hosts can reuse a cached file index across sessions, avoiding repeated tree-sitter CPU and wasm memory cost.

dde3b3223f5082e1ce6c3d890dfaee4a1c5e91f4.title: Session counter moved inside model selector scrollbox
dde3b3223f5082e1ce6c3d890dfaee4a1c5e91f4.summary: Relocated session usage counter from fixed landing screen area into model selector's scrollbox. Adjusted layout calculations to prevent viewport shrinkage while content grows.

65f20efb85fbaa7d2ec42f484fbbf9b39c57f751.title: CrofAI GLM 5.2 model added to Web picker
65f20efb85fbaa7d2ec42f484fbbf9b39c57f751.summary: Added `crof/glm-5.2` to Freebuff Web model list for full-access users. This route has a dedicated daily quota of 1 session, separate from the shared premium pool. Limited regions cannot access this model.

25b2071a417f2e28570f4f40d4cfede17d45a0e7.title: Add TTFT histogram utilities for latency rollups
25b2071a417f2e28570f4f40d4cfede17d45a0e7.summary: New `ttft-histogram.ts` in `common/src/util` provides log-scale bucketing, index/midpoint conversion, and percentile calculation for time-to-first-token data. Enables additive histogram rollups for the /latency dashboard p50/p95 metrics.

075723dbdc661304e710e2b305277f3acfef3101.title: GLM 5.2 quota merged; default model persistence fixed
075723dbdc661304e710e2b305277f3acfef3101.summary: CrofAI GLM 5.2 now draws from shared daily premium pool, removing 1-session/day cap. New logic prevents saving GLM models as user defaults to avoid admission failures on reload.

f377278c442149319ba818d05791b4012b9cf3b5.title: Fix model selector layout and update recommended model
f377278c442149319ba818d05791b4012b9cf3b5.summary: Updated the recommended premium model from MiniMax M3 to DeepSeek V4 Pro. Refactored the model selector to always display warnings and deployment hours on a separate line, preventing long text from dominating the screen. Adjusted minimum terminal height to ensure the recommended card's border remains visible on short terminals.

c8e487a6246813b34d1f8a6942bef69352c80bc4.title: Cloud planner uses MiniMax M3, adds build model split
c8e487a6246813b34d1f8a6942bef69352c80bc4.summary: Cloud planner now defaults to MiniMax M3 for better reasoning quality. Build execution remains on DeepSeek V4 Pro, requiring a new session hand-off. Added turn limits and validation for build model selection.

b81352e298d504578da3e408754a0274dbcbacd2.title: Add desktop worktree reclaim analytics event
b81352e298d504578da3e408754a0274dbcbacd2.summary: Added `DESKTOP_WORKTREES_RECLAIMED` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Internal telemetry addition.

24c1a306f8c6654c7412241acd117c8074af5831.title: Simplify Terms and Privacy Policy notice summary
24c1a306f8c6654c7412241acd117c8074af5831.summary: Shortened the summary text in the policy rollout notice constants. Content remains semantically equivalent but is more concise.

6fbfd71dd51c396171b911b5fc3894984e0a3dd9.title: Freebuff adds base2-lite-evals agent
6fbfd71dd51c396171b911b5fc3894984e0a3dd9.summary: New `base2-lite-evals` agent definition added for evaluation purposes. Internal refactoring of `createBase2` separates `isFreebuff` and `isLean` logic, updates model/reviewer mappings, and adjusts system prompts for lite mode.

1499a9d866f9946dca7209a07323b0c4b501c60b.title: Revert client tool result dedup guard
1499a9d866f9946dca7209a07323b0c4b501c60b.summary: Removed `dedupeClientToolResults` logic. Agent runtime now appends all client tool results directly to message history without checking for duplicate `tool_call_id`s.

ac163119e1412375e526494c81ec179739f4ced4.title: Web/Cloud default model change to DeepSeek V4 Pro
ac163119e1412375e526494c81ec179739f4ced4.summary: New Web/Cloud users now default to DeepSeek V4 Pro for cost efficiency, distinct from CLI/Desktop's MiniMax M3. Note: DeepSeek V4 Pro uses training data, so pickers must display the associated warning. Premium models MiniMax M3 and Kimi K2.7 are deemphasized in the Web picker UI.

d281d6eedd789ca6b8590df20edb4388379408f4.title: Fix tool result message ordering for media outputs
d281d6eedd789ca6b8590df20edb4388379408f4.summary: Updated `convertToolResultMessage` to ensure tool result messages always precede media-derived user messages. This prevents provider errors where images in tool outputs caused unpaired tool calls.

9b8e85b8d0d50bfc0c1bffe9caa17eee7798d1bf.title: Add desktop.turn_background_wait analytics event
9b8e85b8d0d50bfc0c1bffe9caa17eee7798d1bf.summary: New `DESKTOP_TURN_BACKGROUND_WAIT` event added to track turns paused by background commands. Included in `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` to ensure accurate reliability metrics without sampling loss.

9b8ffc8ef8c48601dc234a57e45ebc83b498a5f5.title: Add Ling 3.0 Flash model, switch cloud planner to DeepSeek V4 Pro
9b8ffc8ef8c48601dc234a57e45ebc83b498a5f5.summary: New `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free` model added to god-mode-only web picker. Cloud planner agent model switched from MiniMax M3 to DeepSeek V4 Pro. CLI version bumped to 0.0.129.

cb202d14e1327ee923368b2dc099364b372dac68.title: Added Freebuff Cloud planner agents and daily limits
cb202d14e1327ee923368b2dc099364b372dac68.summary: Introduced `base2-free-cloud-planner` and `base2-free-cloud-planner-limited` agents to support custom-stack planning. Added `FREEBUFF_CLOUD_BLANK_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT` (5/day) for blank projects.

2a8c8af1fba063ed768cafb0e9585b8f560a25fe.title: Testing docs: baseline drift, no-test warnings, flaky annotations
2a8c8af1fba063ed768cafb0e9585b8f560a25fe.summary: Docs now explain why stale test baselines silently gut the guard, using measured drift (971 recorded vs 1278 actual, 307 tests unguarded). Adds guidance on `Suite ran no tests` warnings and the new `Flaky suite` annotation emitted when a retried job passes.

4fa56551886ce92ff07d05bc42107ed53ae03a5f.title: Add analytics events for desktop autorun

977abd5ce06611d6fe900d31310c581dfcd95291.title: Docs: CI optimization and testing performance guide
977abd5ce06611d6fe900d31310c581dfcd95291.summary: Added documentation detailing CI pipeline optimizations, including job un-gating, typecheck lane splitting, and SDK caching strategies. Includes performance analysis, known bottlenecks, and best practices for measuring test execution time.

622a2a2228556af643a2addd266099af434504f5.title: Add desktop.feature_used analytics event
622a2a2228556af643a2addd266099af434504f5.summary: New `DESKTOP_FEATURE_USED` event tracks feature adoption across desktop app. Added to `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` to ensure accurate unique-user metrics.

8e956567928c769287011b3a1b8974d8d646631a.title: Add per-package test env fixtures and CI guard docs
8e956567928c769287011b3a1b8974d8d646631a.summary: Added `cli/bunfig.toml` and `common/bunfig.toml` to preload env fixtures, preventing silent test file failures in package-local runs. Updated `docs/testing.md` with rules for env fixtures, service skipping, and CI test-count baselines.

860318a19c3c2bd12795963a2e50917ca79e0ba5.title: Docs: monorepo shared-state test failures
860318a19c3c2bd12795963a2e50917ca79e0ba5.summary: Added section on monorepo-wide sweep finding shared-state patterns in `cli` tests. Details `mkdtemp` fix for fixed-path writes in working tree and `os.tmpdir`.

a74c20dc1479774fddf8507f9d9d4ca9e7b6d8f9.title: Add flake-hunt docs and CI workflow
a74c20dc1479774fddf8507f9d9d4ca9e7b6d8f9.summary: Documented `scripts/flake-hunt.ts` for reproducing CI flakes under load. Added `flake-hunt.yml` workflow. Detailed guidance on fixing shared state, polling, and timer leaks.

801a9d02c935e19c2f9529d1330b0de6eac555c4.title: Basher skips LLM summarization for short output
801a9d02c935e19c2f9529d1330b0de6eac555c4.summary: Basher agent now returns raw command output if under 2000 chars, even when `what_to_summarize` is set. Prevents unnecessary LLM latency for small results.

cb153c1518104ed5254b2189f9dd5d5794600fef.title: Add event loop health analytics event
cb153c1518104ed5254b2189f9dd5d5794600fef.summary: Added `DESKTOP_EVENT_LOOP_HEALTH` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. This tracks orchestrator event loop saturation to distinguish backend queueing from local UI hangs.

c9bdd9c7b58e05b498d296cf64fcaaa3db54890d.title: Fix duplicate tool_call_id rejection in agent runtime
c9bdd9c7b58e05b498d296cf64fcaaa3db54890d.summary: Added dedupeClientToolResults to filter duplicate tool results from SDK retries. Prevents provider errors ('Duplicate value for tool_call_id') that previously wedged entire conversation threads.

8e2ef71f5db6f210951e6086acaa0618bf80e055.title: Switch helper agents to Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite
8e2ef71f5db6f210951e6086acaa0618bf80e055.summary: Updated basher, browser-use, file-explorer, and researcher agents to use `GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_LITE_MODEL_ID`. Allowed both 3.5 and 3.1 models in `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` to prevent 403 errors for older clients.

d00f185a4d65a008126a1fbe4e4516fbf003414d.title: Retire desktop inline ad pool reuse event
d00f185a4d65a008126a1fbe4e4516fbf003414d.summary: Removed `DESKTOP_INLINE_AD_POOL_REUSED` from analytics constants. Desktop ads now use inline parts with a max count cap instead of a head-pool model. Historical data remains, but no new events are emitted for this metric.

3c92d4e7bd963920744771f9af70a7740f5db53b.title: Chat auto-prunes context to prevent long-thread failures
3c92d4e7bd963920744771f9af70a7740f5db53b.summary: Chat now automatically summarizes long conversations before each step, preventing provider rejections when context limits are exceeded. This ensures threads remain usable even after switching to models with smaller context windows.

1402b75d5bd6d305c9bb326da1e9fb0c60a4b35e.title: Opus agents upgrade to claude-opus-5
1402b75d5bd6d305c9bb326da1e9fb0c60a4b35e.summary: Opus-tier agents (editor, reviewer, general) now use `anthropic/claude-opus-5`. Model IDs centralized in `OPUS_MODEL` constant to prevent drift.

0ff93e746badad951717b0a70386bf5b24701517.title: Fix 400 errors on DeepSeek after interrupted turns
0ff93e746badad951717b0a70386bf5b24701517.summary: Agent runtime now filters unfinished tool calls from history before building requests. This prevents strict providers like DeepSeek from rejecting subsequent turns with 400 errors after an interruption. Also hardened message filtering to handle non-array content gracefully.

326a33d9c24c462f1640172b775db7a368e84e56.title: Clarify cloud-plan-ready summary field description
326a33d9c24c462f1640172b775db7a368e84e56.summary: Updated the `summary` parameter description in `cloud-plan-ready.ts` to explicitly state it should be one short sentence, with implementation details moved to `build_prompt`.

2d0defa35f3f84fc905fcc5fd0d677726ff4d32b.title: Added anthropic/claude-opus-5 model support
2d0defa35f3f84fc905fcc5fd0d677726ff4d32b.summary: Added `anthropic/claude-opus-5` to `ModelName` type definitions and OpenRouter mapping constants. Users can now select this model in agent configurations.

c731787cd02fea9b5d37c9e5e6fb06c0e3897045.title: CLI polling jitter + exponential backoff
c731787cd02fea9b5d37c9e5e6fb06c0e3897045.summary: CLI now jitters healthy poll intervals and exponentially backs off on failures. Prevents synchronized retry storms during outages. Respects server `Retry-After` headers.

086e7bfc29fc3edd9f62a2eddbdc8821ff71b409.title: SDK: surface raw HTTP errors in startAgentRun
086e7bfc29fc3edd9f62a2eddbdc8821ff71b409.summary: Added console.error logs for failed requests, missing runId, and exceptions in `startAgentRun` to bypass logger allowlist restrictions.

04bceb38336bd18978e6c75daa2b1451b3f51c8d.title: Context-pruner cache expiry 30min, local token count, untracked runs
04bceb38336bd18978e6c75daa2b1451b3f51c8d.summary: Context-pruner now uses 30-minute cache expiry instead of 5-minute default, preventing unnecessary lossy re-summarization after short idle periods. Token counting switched to local estimation for all runs, removing web API round-trip overhead from every step. Context-pruner runs are now untracked, skipping three awaited ledger round-trips per main-agent step.

ef69165e2f7db1192f722d33574d63f4d4bc8f4a.title: Signup free credits disabled
ef69165e2f7db1192f722d33574d63f4d4bc8f4a.summary: The `SIGNUP_FREE_CREDITS_GRANT` constant set to `0`. New accounts receive no signup credits. Re-enabling requires restoring GitHub-link hook and pricing copy.

9960f1f7021572ab6422137dd38830ec6587af47.title: cloud-plan-ready: add required_integrations param
9960f1f7021572ab6422137dd38830ec6587af47.summary: New `required_integrations` field added to `cloud-plan-ready` tool input schema. Requires array of objects with `slug` and `name` for Gravity services needing credentials.

3b621851400cd86740de15406b74d8f020832c01.title: Streak GLM bonus now scales up to 4x weekly
3b621851400cd86740de15406b74d8f020832c01.summary: Weekly GLM 5.2 bonus for full-access users now scales with streak length: 1 session per 7-day milestone (e.g., 14 days = 2/week), capped at 4 sessions for streaks of 28+ days. CLI streak progress notes updated to reflect current weekly count.

99f8bdf7238772049723aee6d133b9e2af05e10c.title: Secure Gravity Index CTA resolution & tool error handling
99f8bdf7238772049723aee6d133b9e2af05e10c.summary: Added `gravity-index-cta.ts` to securely resolve tracked setup links from `gravity_index` searches, preventing URL hallucination. Updated `render_ui` to accept reference objects instead of raw URLs. Improved agent runtime to prevent ending turns when tool calls fail.

a6064e62018ea29f9349570ff051500030870c1d.title: Add DESKTOP_PROJECT_REMOVED analytics event
a6064e62018ea29f9349570ff051500030870c1d.summary: Added `DESKTOP_PROJECT_REMOVED` constant to `AnalyticsEvent` enum for tracking project removal actions in desktop app.

ff555dfc23f4037715103ed7983c5e934eae5555.title: Shared streak logic + pre-milestone countdown note
ff555dfc23f4037715103ed7983c5e934eae5555.summary: Streak line logic moved to `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts` for CLI/Desktop reuse. `getFreebuffStreakBonusNote` now shows "N more days to unlock" below 7-day milestone.

1614c75f6c19c5cd6ee24e0fab2d21382e012e0c.title: Fix Windows command errors
1614c75f6c19c5cd6ee24e0fab2d21382e012e0c.summary: Terminal commands now run in bash on all OSes. Windows redirections to `nul` are rewritten to `/dev/null` to prevent file creation errors. Tool instructions updated to enforce POSIX syntax.

95d0fd6d9160780a76fe40fd4f79bb21858f0d91.title: Gravity index links now verified via render_ui
95d0fd6d9160780a76fe40fd4f79bb21858f0d91.summary: Added render_ui to base-chat agent toolNames. Chat now uses render_ui to present verified Gravity index links instead of raw URLs. Updated cloud-plan-ready schema to require search_id for integrations.

aa75163a8f27b8cfc8af9d2ce07ba5f3253fdce0.title: Privacy policy update. Data-use notice. Model training labels
aa75163a8f27b8cfc8af9d2ce07ba5f3253fdce0.summary: Updated Terms and Privacy Policy effective July 23, 2026. Prompts may be analyzed to personalize ads. AI training applies only to models labeled 'May use data for AI training'. Model selector updated with machine-readable `dataUse` field. DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro now explicitly flagged for training. Other models (MiMo, Kimi, HY3, MiniMax) set to `service` only.

19ef71044ca314d9713b6f291ef272abbcc58724.title: Remove NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN env var
19ef71044ca314d9713b6f291ef272abbcc58724.summary: Removed the `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN` environment variable and its validation logic from the shared client environment schema. This simplifies the configuration by eliminating the comma-separated runtime origin list.

aff0092445df1aceda16b73f9435f9121831fa44.title: CLI: chat-state saves survive cyclic/oversized payloads
aff0092445df1aceda16b73f9435f9121831fa44.summary: Adds `cli/src/utils/safe-json.ts` to rescue chat-state serialization when transcripts contain cyclic objects or exceed string limits. `run-state-storage.ts` now serializes run state and messages independently, logs environment/payload failures as rate-limited warnings instead of repeated errors, and no longer lets a poisoned payload block persisting the transcript.

2d3b8b08b30dd13c6590106ec5eb4720ffd18215.title: HY3 Atlas Model Now Routes via OpenRouter
2d3b8b08b30dd13c6590106ec5eb4720ffd18215.summary: The 'HY3 Atlas' model has been updated to route through OpenRouter instead of direct Atlas Cloud. This change affects model availability and routing for paid HY3 selections, ensuring consistency with the OpenRouter integration.

ed223e710e22a010882d619831743d1c66d4ce9c.title: SDK: recover streams severed by thrown network errors
ed223e710e22a010882d619831743d1c66d4ce9c.summary: Stream handling now catches exceptions thrown when a response body is severed mid-connection. These transient network drops trigger the same capped continuation path as clean incomplete endings, preserving partial output and forcing a fresh agent step.

84b194f1de686f37ab0e471ed617e9aa9ecdb61d.title: Add desktop feedback source, appVersion, platform fields
84b194f1de686f37ab0e471ed617e9aa9ecdb61d.summary: Feedback sources now include 'desktop'. Schema accepts optional appVersion and platform strings for richer context.

9ac3cfaccbda1e5eefac4a136587406f1bf5fe83.title: Fix path traversal in isFileIgnored
9ac3cfaccbda1e5eefac4a136587406f1bf5fe83.summary: Added `isPathInside` helper to validate file paths against project root before processing gitignore rules. Prevents `isFileIgnored` from returning incorrect results for paths outside the project root.

380909638150bde314b3d4eb96bcd7664fa07529.title: Unify CLI exit handling and harden launcher env
380909638150bde314b3d4eb96bcd7664fa07529.summary: Refactored CLI shutdown logic into a shared `exitCliCleanly` utility, replacing scattered `process.exit` calls and `SIGINT` signals across commands, hooks, and screens. The launcher now explicitly passes `CODEBUFF_LAUNCHER_PID` to child processes while preserving other environment options. Startup error handling was hardened to ensure terminal state restoration even if standard output streams fail.

4aa3d4c337e0d6424a23184465fdd0d98b1d387f.title: SDK caps subprocess output, prevents OOM
4aa3d4c337e0d6424a23184465fdd0d98b1d387f.summary: Added per-stream limit (10MB) to subprocess output collection in `run-state.ts`. Prevents `RangeError: Out of memory` on huge git diffs by killing child process at cap. `getGitChanges` now logs truncation and exports for testing.

c11ed01ddcbcb4bb5477850724e03e3bce8441e5.title: Laguna S 2.1 model added
c11ed01ddcbcb4bb5477850724e03e3bce8441e5.summary: Added Poolside Laguna S 2.1 model. Currently god-mode only. Premium status.

21e20ab6257f3141ddca47ec45624e70688a4bc1.title: Remove concurrent_sessions reason from rate_limited status
21e20ab6257f3141ddca47ec45624e70688a4bc1.summary: The `reason?: 'concurrent_sessions'` field has been removed from the `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` type when status is `rate_limited`. Clients should no longer expect this specific discriminator for concurrent-tab backstops, simplifying the rejection handling logic to rely solely on quota limits.

7f0aadcf9dac5265474b698062f1d51776223fd8.title: Support comma-separated runtime origins in env schema
7f0aadcf9dac5265474b698062f1d51776223fd8.summary: Updated `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN` to accept comma-separated list of URLs. First entry is canonical. All entries must be valid URLs.

6a8bd574f8f06b5f519397bf8b066709ab784545.title: Add OpenRouter model alias for Poolside Laguna S 2.1
6a8bd574f8f06b5f519397bf8b066709ab784545.summary: Introduced a new internal model alias `openrouter/poolside/laguna-s-2.1` to allow independent testing of the paid OpenRouter route alongside the direct Poolside API. This change updates the god-mode-only model lists and constants to support the new routing configuration.

3dc5a86f835786fcd0a763eb9fd027c58e732ba5.title: Add WebContainer env schema fields
3dc5a86f835786fcd0a763eb9fd027c58e732ba5.summary: Added NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN to client env schema. These fields are optional.

f832b44401fb12895cc2023f6e4daf776f7edd74.title: Remove NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_API_KEY from env schema
f832b44401fb12895cc2023f6e4daf776f7edd74.summary: Deleted the optional `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_API_KEY` variable from the client environment schema and its process environment mapping in `common/src/env-schema.ts`. This cleans up unused configuration.

de58a616b9b0ca15d0fba59c68fe8b7e19ef2fb5.title: Add desktop turn stall telemetry
de58a616b9b0ca15d0fba59c68fe8b7e19ef2fb5.summary: Added `DESKTOP_TURN_STALLED` analytics event to track turns with no stream activity. This is a passive detector for reliability data; turns are not aborted. The event is always tracked to ensure accurate counting.

23bcdc85d8b5bee8a0e5c41da85a4fd00a56028e.title: Add affiliate signup and activation analytics events
23bcdc85d8b5bee8a0e5c41da85a4fd00a56028e.summary: Two new analytics events (`FREEBUFF_AFFILIATE_SIGNUP`, `FREEBUFF_AFFILIATE_ACTIVATION`) added to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` for tracking affiliate conversions.

d6ec35acf28349f0742cb015e2400f5d07d83eb0.title: Refactor freebuff session API into dedicated util module
d6ec35acf28349f0742cb015e2400f5d07d83eb0.summary: Extracted session fetching, slot management, and error handling logic from `use-freebuff-session.ts` into new `cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-api.ts`. Updated imports in `chat-runtime-context.tsx` and `index.tsx` to use the new module. No user-facing behavior changes.

6741ac4a35ff3d5b290540a363ae19c6c5c485cf.title: Reddit CAPI conversion events unified, retry, deterministic ID
6741ac4a35ff3d5b290540a363ae19c6c5c485cf.summary: Reddit CAPI custom events now use unified names (FirstPrompt, Retention1d/7d/24d) instead of surface-specific variants. Conversion delivery adds one-retry on transient failures, deterministic `sha256` conversion IDs, and email normalization strips `+`/dots from local part. `clickId` moved from user payload into `event_source_url` as `rdt_cid` query param.

74ee22bd83306ec1e06b515b52e03e43a31b41cd.title: Daily session limit increased 5 to 6
74ee22bd83306ec1e06b515b52e03e43a31b41cd.summary: Premium and limited mode daily session limits raised from 5 to 6. Referral cap math updated to reflect new base.

21d02b63f7a0e4b97b0e825243a70231d24de6fc.title: Added internal CrofAI GLM 5.2 route for god-mode testing
21d02b63f7a0e4b97b0e825243a70231d24de6fc.summary: Introduced `base2-free-glm-crof` agent and `crof/glm-5.2` model ID to test CrofAI independently from the standard Fireworks route. This model is restricted to god-mode users and marked as experimental.

31731d4b275ad637ad19e9531442b3f5acaa8d7f.title: Add stream recovery logging and prototype pollution guards
31731d4b275ad637ad19e9531442b3f5acaa8d7f.summary: Introduced a new `stream_recovery` logging event to track stream interruptions and successful recoveries. Refactored the allowlist logging utility to support multiple events with strict type checking and added prototype pollution guards to prevent arbitrary string keys from matching via the prototype chain.

ace6dfaa46c3c14d6ce640c5146a1110df23d57f.title: Move thinker spawn limit rule in base2 prompt
ace6dfaa46c3c14d6ce640c5146a1110df23d57f.summary: Repositioned the `THINKER_SPAWN_LIMIT` instruction within the `base2.ts` agent prompt. Removed the limit from the implementation step prompt builder. Internal prompt logic adjustment.

b3680bc95f78bcedbcb5b13ae1b18a4f4bb2aa8e.title: Reduce Freebuff streak bonus min height
b3680bc95f78bcedbcb5b13ae1b18a4f4bb2aa8e.summary: Internal CLI utility `freebuff-streak-line.ts` updated `FREEBUFF_STREAK_BONUS_MIN_HEIGHT` constant from 52 to 30.

8785289028f63c9a6d0f34de8380e3de400c1f3c.title: CLI: Fix collapsed session counter, auto-switch exhausted premium to fallback
8785289028f63c9a6d0f34de8380e3de400c1f3c.summary: Landing screen now shows session counter when picker is collapsed. Session-ended banner automatically switches to unlimited fallback model if premium quota is exhausted, preventing dead-end rate-limit screens.

0b35949fad7bbaf605afbd048ca912c14d4a3173.title: Add cloud_plan_ready tool for blank project approval
0b35949fad7bbaf605afbd048ca912c14d4a3173.summary: New `cloud_plan_ready` tool allows agents to mark blank Freebuff Cloud project plans as ready for user approval. This triggers a "Start building" button in the UI without initiating implementation.

68d2a1c12fcf666d7d4d067a3f00e5953afebd34.title: Enforce single thinker agent spawn per request
68d2a1c12fcf666d7d4d067a3f00e5953afebd34.summary: Base2 agent now limits thinker spawns to one per user request. This prevents redundant agent usage and controls costs.

908988675e48fa01e64a50b5f9ac2410d06900dd.title: Fix hidden agent rendering in CLI
908988675e48fa01e64a50b5f9ac2410d06900dd.summary: CLI now correctly hides `context-pruner` agent blocks. Added logic to strip these blocks from restored transcripts and handle live streaming filtering.

8b1e3056a8678ddbcd1f18cf505017accb927cfd.title: llm-providers: bump @ai-sdk/provider 2.0.3, infer failedResponseHandler types
8b1e3056a8678ddbcd1f18cf505017accb927cfd.summary: llm-providers updated @ai-sdk/provider to 2.0.3. OpenAI-compatible chat and completion language models now derive `failedResponseHandler` type via `ReturnType<typeof createJsonErrorResponseHandler>` instead of explicit `ResponseHandler<APICallError>` generics.

ff901fe20bad843eac69657fe3f446d4285af737.title: Auto-retry interrupted streams
ff901fe20bad843eac69657fe3f446d4285af737.summary: Freebuff now detects and auto-retries interrupted streams and output-limit errors. The CLI shows a transient retrying status during recovery.

f306a65c7959b621b722d98e361dedf64a575a88.title: suggest_prompts tool exempt from next-step forcing
f306a65c7959b621b722d98e361dedf64a575a88.summary: Added `suggest_prompts` to `TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP` in `common/src/tools/constants.ts`. This prevents the agent from being forced to execute a next step immediately after suggesting prompts.

9262d077baa57360516b372dae789cd193f7a15a.title: Add web standard model session limit
9262d077baa57360516b372dae789cd193f7a15a.summary: Introduced a 6-session daily cap for full-access web/cloud models to deter automated churn. CLI remains unlimited; new constants define the web standard pool and reset schedule.

92ff02610686d5d9fc79060254e0ba759de87c76.title: Landing screen layout: drop text wordmark, smarter streak note
92ff02610686d5d9fc79060254e0ba759de87c76.summary: Removed compact text wordmark from landing screen. Full ASCII logo shown only when height permits, else hidden to maximize model list rows. Streak bonus note now layout-aware, only rendering on tall terminals where it fits on one line.

6501764d584c609c88de49fbb649c5b5f055c3d9.title: spawn-agent-inline: subagent chunk routing and context-pruner lifecycle
6501764d584c609c88de49fbb649c5b5f055c3d9.summary: Refactored `onResponseChunk` to route text chunks via `sendSubagentChunk` and pass structured objects to `writeToClient`. Context-pruner now suppresses raw text but allows `subagent_start`/`subagent_finish` lifecycle events to reach client.

4b03dcbd2a7791366306ab976dba52fd9659b6d6.title: Added Gravity CAPI integration for first message events
4b03dcbd2a7791366306ab976dba52fd9659b6d6.summary: New `common/src/gravity-capi.ts` module. Implements payload building, input sanitization, and sending of `FirstMessage` conversion events to Gravity API.

35474f6bf77e51e4dbcf3773cbb0ebf5c30d6fe7.title: Fix orphaned runs overwriting chats on switch
35474f6bf77e51e4dbcf3773cbb0ebf5c30d6fe7.summary: Replaced `abortActiveRun` with `stopActiveRun` to centrally manage run termination and queue policies. Prevents in-flight AI runs from checkpointing or writing to the wrong chat directory during history resume, new chat creation, or logout.

b6199c08ae729268fb8e37886fe7608ee7c7c17c.title: CLI shows weekly reset and session entitlement breakdown
b6199c08ae729268fb8e37886fe7608ee7c7c17c.summary: Landing screen now displays 'this week' instead of 'today' for weekly quotas and updates reset instructions. Session types include optional `entitlementBreakdown` (base, referral, streak) to detail quota limits.

94f0f052111d7430d1cc973c9653333d045e5f6d.title: MiMo 2.5 Pro multimodal disabled
94f0f052111d7430d1cc973c9653333d045e5f6d.summary: MiMo 2.5 Pro now marked text-only to prevent provider rejections on image inputs. Multimodal model lists derived dynamically from model capabilities.

ea226cb387463c614ad636bf2fa368cca721099c.title: Fix Context7 token truncation and API migration
ea226cb387463c614ad636bf2fa368cca721099c.summary: Migrated Context7 integration to v2 API endpoints and added precise token budget truncation for documentation responses. Reduced default `max_tokens` to 10,000 and enforced strict input validation for library and topic queries.

16931ade9e64c9e5a453642da335cf4b08ed6093.title: Add FreebuffActiveSessionInfo type for multi-session clients
16931ade9e64c9e5a453642da335cf4b08ed6093.summary: New `FreebuffActiveSessionInfo` interface added to `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. Includes `model`, `admittedAt`, and `expiresAt` fields to help clients display active session windows.

e78563f1e523d46e46a3234eeb84bb3e77cb9b4b.title: CLI: Refactor chat state into runtime context
e78563f1e523d46e46a3234eeb84bb3e77cb9b4b.summary: Introduced `ChatRuntimeProvider` to manage chat state and hooks centrally. Updated `App` and `Chat` components to consume the new context, replacing scattered prop drilling and direct hook usage.

6655cc5ad6e660c64cbca9251ef019eecf59dde9.title: Fix CLI stream status flicker on remount
6655cc5ad6e660c64cbca9251ef019eecf59dde9.summary: Chat UI now stays 'streaming' if a run continues during temporary unmounts. Interrupt logic uses active-run registry to prevent abort failures.

e8c2211146a5a3fd3718e8dee4825c4757e60986.title: Add analytics events for harness CLI lifecycle
e8c2211146a5a3fd3718e8dee4825c4757e60986.summary: Added three new analytics events to track harness CLI shutdown and recovery: `DESKTOP_SHUTDOWN_TURNS_ABORTED`, `DESKTOP_ORPHANS_REAPED`, and `DESKTOP_TURNS_RESURRECTED`. These events help monitor how often users encounter orphaned CLI processes.

1328a3f288ed36e8ee37a3aac1b8ca1efff52cd6.title: Add browser-safe Freebuff model ID constants
1328a3f288ed36e8ee37a3aac1b8ca1efff52cd6.summary: Extracted `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` and `FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID` into new dependency-free module `common/src/constants/freebuff-model-ids.ts`. Re-exported from `freebuff-models.ts` to maintain compatibility while enabling safe browser imports.

1b952b35d6dac171d48c8e0fd7daf70c873a40b5.title: Add codex resolution analytics event
1b952b35d6dac171d48c8e0fd7daf70c873a40b5.summary: New `DESKTOP_CODEX_RESOLUTION` event tracks which codex CLI the harness resolves. Ensured to always track via sampling config.

4ccefe89dc731502797440fa56faa60e1417f9eb.title: Refactor model utils, remove legacy referral analytics
4ccefe89dc731502797440fa56faa60e1417f9eb.summary: Moved `isExplicitlyDefinedModel` to `model-config` to resolve circular dependency issues. Removed unused `referral.completed` and `referral.sweep` analytics events. Updated documentation for referral constants.

ed5c777e9ea95739a4f2484a600d096304e6a3e3.title: Clarify streak bonus units comment
ed5c777e9ea95739a4f2484a600d096304e6a3e3.summary: Updated the comment for `FREEBUFF_STREAK_BONUS_SESSION_UNITS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to describe session units as being added to an eligible streak-reward pool.

d24c97e0aa12993c710b9495edbe6315550f9910.title: Move ad user-agent to shared common util
d24c97e0aa12993c710b9495edbe6315550f9910.summary: Refactor ad targeting user-agent logic from CLI hook to new shared utility `common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts`. Adds platform normalization for macOS/Windows.

5b05edcad1c49dbfae18bb40a3a8026b8b5673c6.title: Streak GLM bonus refills weekly, stops on break
5b05edcad1c49dbfae18bb40a3a8026b8b5673c6.summary: GLM 5.2 streak reward now refills every Monday while streak stays 7+ days, and shuts off immediately when streak breaks. Daily premium/limited bonus persists after first use. Streak reward pools split into daily-persisted and GLM-live-derived paths.

fd7faf65bf78df2e9a52f592853b2ee7e2ead054.title: Fix str_replace/write_file failing on large files in SDK
fd7faf65bf78df2e9a52f592853b2ee7e2ead054.summary: SDK now allows internal edit tools to bypass content limits when reading files. This ensures exact matches work for replacements below the display limit in large files.

c931d187e9c094739c6acc86ec1c583dc9319d51.title: SDK adds userId passthrough for agent runs and LLM calls
c931d187e9c094739c6acc86ec1c583dc9319d51.summary: SDK `run`, agent lifecycle functions, and LLM request paths now accept optional `userId` and send it via `FREEBUFF_ACTING_USER_HEADER`. Types add `GetUserInfoByIdInput` and `GetUserInfoByIdFn`.

ef2019f26ece398825b6dbe8451e9b5aec3be563.title: CLI: new daily spend limit screen
ef2019f26ece398825b6dbe8451e9b5aec3be563.summary: Added 'spend_limited' status to session types. Landing screen now shows a message when daily provider-spend budget is hit, replacing generic errors. Existing sessions continue uninterrupted.

9db53d4c2136be67ada35d5716835b1bdb6fa07d.title: Desktop agent IDs split by execution mode
9db53d4c2136be67ada35d5716835b1bdb6fa07d.summary: Added `getFreebuffDesktopThreadAgentId` to generate distinct root agent IDs for local and worktree modes, replacing the single unsuffixed ID. This improves trace and cache identity while maintaining backward compatibility for older clients.

10fb028c168f112636f95dc76cc992a67819940e.title: read_files tool enforces shared token and character limits
10fb028c168f112636f95dc76cc992a67819940e.summary: The `read_files` tool now applies a shared 20,000 estimated-token limit and a 100,000-character hard limit across all files in a single call. Content exceeding these limits is truncated with specific notices, and duplicate file paths are skipped.

7dbf452bebddc6dd0ea8d46809d425a182a44753.title: Remove KAT Coder Pro V2 model
7dbf452bebddc6dd0ea8d46809d425a182a44753.summary: Removed KAT Coder Pro V2 from Freebuff Web models, premium lists, and allowed prefixes. Updated limited-tier geo-exempt model documentation and logic.

a793b16ecd43ca8d61e002222b2c9f8f8614880b.title: CLI landing: move referral card into model selector scrollbox
a793b16ecd43ca8d61e002222b2c9f8f8614880b.summary: Referral banner moved into model selector scrollbox. Removed `freebuff-landing-focus-store`. Logo promotion now skips mid-height windows with referral menu.

9ef7e7f28943c8ab971309b595bafd08d00d7b3a.title: Add resumable downloads and HTTP proxy support to CLI
9ef7e7f28943c8ab971309b595bafd08d00d7b3a.summary: Implemented `downloadFile` with resume capability using `Range` headers and partial file persistence. Added support for `HTTP_PROXY` environment variable for non-HTTPS requests and improved error reporting for download failures.

191fd58e6fbdcd4f428da59d556490c152d2361f.title: Add axiom-only log support, context pruning telemetry
191fd58e6fbdcd4f428da59d556490c152d2361f.summary: New `axiom-only-log.ts` util enables operational logs to bypass PostHog and ship raw data to Axiom. Context pruner now emits detailed telemetry on pruning events. Logger updated to respect axiom-only flag.

0fbf0d3b2edb429bb9f489b15af7022062d7e7ec.title: Add noGravityIndex flag to base2 agent and GLM_V52 model to free-agents
0fbf0d3b2edb429bb9f489b15af7022062d7e7ec.summary: Added `noGravityIndex` option to `createBase2` to optionally disable the `gravity_index` tool and related prompt instructions. Added `FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID` to the `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` constant.

1de3f90a35a3cdef2dd3c3cbaee5d8dee637889e.title: Bump package version to 0.0.122
1de3f90a35a3cdef2dd3c3cbaee5d8dee637889e.summary: Updated release package version from 0.0.121 to 0.0.122.

4e24162fc7e8d8a5ebc827b26c3afc48c6ed057f.title: Fix context pruner to protect user/assistant budgets independently
4e24162fc7e8d8a5ebc827b26c3afc48c6ed057f.summary: The context pruner now tracks token budgets for user and assistant/tool roles separately. Previously, exhausting one role's budget would stop the entire pruning process, potentially evicting entries from the other role. This ensures recent user prompts are kept even if assistant history is large, and vice versa.

dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.title: Add /diagnostics command and Windows process tree kill
dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.summary: Added a new `/diagnostics` slash command to CLI to show local resource usage and active terminal tool PIDs. Improved process termination on Windows to prevent orphaned grandchildren. Refactored chat state to preserve focus settings across chats.

2bb0662c5dd481ddb3bb79db171548568e33e9a5.title: Refactor CLI release launchers to shared core
2bb0662c5dd481ddb3bb79db171548568e33e9a5.summary: Moved launcher and HTTP client logic into `cli/release-core`. Release packages now copy these files during `prepack` and remove them in `postpack`. Updated `.gitignore` to exclude generated release files.

75c94becef9f223a3266bab4840d4594ae3e8fe8.title: Adjust ad placement spacing
75c94becef9f223a3266bab4840d4594ae3e8fe8.summary: Updated ad positioning logic. First ad now appears after 2 nodes, subsequent ads every 3 nodes. Internal calculation refined.

c26e125f40313cb18757411f71954c23c3b1cf5f.title: Inline ad banner layout changed
c26e125f40313cb18757411f71954c23c3b1cf5f.summary: Inline ad banners now display title and description on separate rows. Height increased from 3 to 4 lines. Destination label only appears if width >= 48 and variant is domain.

c4a838fedc84d87b1640d62047cc4aa7bff923b4.title: CLI release staging: robust redirects and download retries
c4a838fedc84d87b1640d62047cc4aa7bff923b4.summary: Expanded redirect handling to cover 303/307/308 with loop protection. Added exponential backoff retries for binary downloads and removed redundant proxy error hints.

6e2ec2feb080513c017c65cf5f6aaff9ca564a2e.title: SDK: add loadSkillsSync and parseSkillFileContent exports
6e2ec2feb080513c017c65cf5f6aaff9ca564a2e.summary: New `loadSkillsSync` function added for synchronous skill loading. `parseSkillFileContent` exported to allow parsing skill content without disk access. Existing `loadSkills` remains async-compatible.

d2ae8a0dc59e09d6a13717590ebdd0fd9e2b3dfa.title: CLI: Extract chat header, gate sheen animation
d2ae8a0dc59e09d6a13717590ebdd0fd9e2b3dfa.summary: Moved header logic to `cli/src/components/chat-header.tsx`. Added visibility check to disable sheen animation when header scrolls out of view.

ae87d9cee86c3c4665a0447b4c8cef653c739b76.title: Move response ad logic to shared package
ae87d9cee86c3c4665a0447b4c8cef653c739b76.summary: Refactor CLI ad utilities into `@codebuff/common`. CLI now re-exports shared modules for lazy ads and ad positions. Added analytics events for inline ad slots.

c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.title: CLI 0.0.121: Retire legacy Gemini preview model ID
c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.summary: Added constant for retired `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` model ID. Ensures compatibility with clients released before July 2026.

464115e810f97affdcebc6f7e5485d3664c6956c.title: Prevent chat data corruption on mid-run switches
464115e810f97affdcebc6f7e5485d3664c6956c.summary: New CLI chat switches (via `/new` or history resume) now abort active AI runs. This prevents orphaned background processes from overwriting transcripts with stale data or mixing conversation states.

739b605e24c6307c71c81c8323b3f38563a76ec1.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite model ID update
739b605e24c6307c71c81c8323b3f38563a76ec1.summary: Switched multiple agents from `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` to `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite`. Added shared constant `GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_LITE_MODEL_ID` in `common/src/constants/gemini.ts`.

8e3f104307089d0da674ad22011f2114b5bcf71d.title: SDK: disable MSYS ConPTY allocation on Windows
8e3f104307089d0da674ad22011f2114b5bcf71d.summary: Added `disable_pcon` to `MSYS` environment variable on Windows in `runTerminalCommand` to prevent Git Bash descendants from allocating a ConPTY.

47ef2af4ac5eb7f77c5ae2be02f77801fabf9490.title: Add inline ad telemetry events
47ef2af4ac5eb7f77c5ae2be02f77801fabf9490.summary: New analytics events track eligible ad slots per response and pool reuse. Sampling applied to slot events. No user-visible behavior change.

879cc9e68d329f65c252f1f1473f5d0b37dccd15.title: Fix agent premature turn end on think-only responses
879cc9e68d329f65c252f1f1473f5d0b37dccd15.summary: Agent now correctly continues when model returns only `<think>` scaffolding, including orphan `</think>` tags from native-reasoning providers. Previously, these responses could cause the agent to end its turn prematurely without completing tasks.

2f0296cf9937bb0bc0256849868e81c193f0f472.title: CLI: inline ad cards, lazy pool, new ad utils
2f0296cf9937bb0bc0256849868e81c193f0f472.summary: Adds compact inline ad cards (3-line border, single content row) and a lazy four-ad pool that repeats across transcript slots. New `cli/src/utils/lazy-response-ads.ts` handles pool fill and slot selection; `AdCard` gains a `variant` prop. Above-input rotating slot unchanged.

33192e18252182b6f101ffe9191d2da5fb230c57.title: Kimi K2.7 Code added to model picker
33192e18252182b6f101ffe9191d2da5fb230c57.summary: Kimi K2.7 Code is back in full mode, replacing K2.6. Tagline updated to 'Best for coding'. READMEs and specs reflect new model ID and multimodal support.

c4c5dcd66aaa42cd023a0ad0c146feacf180ebc9.title: Streak bonus now daily for session pool
c4c5dcd66aaa42cd023a0ad0c146feacf180ebc9.summary: The +1 session streak bonus now applies every day once the 7-day streak is active, instead of only on weekly milestones. The weekly GLM 5.2 bonus remains unchanged for full-access users. Copy updated to reflect daily accrual.

4beca76c6485fa3c57a3716650a0eecd996044b4.title: Signup free credits limited to GitHub accounts older than 4 months
4beca76c6485fa3c57a3716650a0eecd996044b4.summary: New `SIGNUP_CREDIT_MIN_GITHUB_ACCOUNT_AGE_MONTHS` constant (4) added to `common/src/constants/limits.ts`. Signup free credits now restricted to GitHub-first users meeting this age threshold; Google-first signups excluded.

1d64a9f44880ccf58e335af1efb24a93ec923831.title: Fix terminal focus detection in CLI
1d64a9f44880ccf58e335af1efb24a93ec923831.summary: Improved how the CLI detects terminal focus events to prevent UI glitches when switching windows or pasting. Now correctly identifies the final focus state even if multiple events arrive together.

e1ce92184215843f83e268d758011594a4a0c8a5.title: Optimize SDK session state cloning for performance
e1ce92184215843f83e268d758011594a4a0c8a5.summary: Replaced expensive `cloneDeep` with faster JSON round-trip for `mainAgentState` in `cloneSessionState`. This reduces snapshot latency from ~230ms to ~4ms, mitigating CLI freezes during long sessions. `fileContext` is now shared by reference.

bc264d00cf190d86d2953e9937afc68c3b371446.title: Fix Web trial subagent 403s, add GLM V52 web model, quota picker support
bc264d00cf190d86d2953e9937afc68c3b371446.summary: Added missing root agent IDs for hy3 and kat-coder-pro-v2 trials to prevent 403 errors on subagent spawning. Included GLM V52 in Freebuff Web models. Added support for a new header to fetch full quota details for the web model picker.

758fdbfedc1bd8c31dee38e5fdf17ae71b7cb67c.title: Fix CLI freezes in long sessions via async checkpointing
758fdbfedc1bd8c31dee38e5fdf17ae71b7cb67c.summary: The CLI now persists chat state asynchronously during active runs to prevent UI freezes in long sessions. Periodic checkpoint saves are coalesced and offloaded from the render/input thread, while final saves remain synchronous to ensure data integrity.

d049aa594eaa6ffe79276ee9358921814f6e3077.title: Relax spawnableAgents validation for inline/prog spawns
d049aa594eaa6ffe79276ee9358921814f6e3077.summary: Updated `DynamicAgentTemplateSchema` refine logic. Non-empty `spawnableAgents` now valid with `spawn_agent_inline` tool or `handleSteps`/`handleStepsFn` generators, not just `spawn_agents`. Error message clarified.

081bdb229790aa903da4ba4462827ba867139ff3.title: Referral banner border uses muted theme color
081bdb229790aa903da4ba4462827ba867139ff3.summary: Updated `freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` to change the border color from `theme.primary` to `theme.muted`. Visual polish for CLI users.

633c256122a18c49ab89171fbcf977a4370c4658.title: CLI ad request drops default surface
633c256122a18c49ab89171fbcf977a4370c4658.summary: Ad request body no longer sends `surface: 'chat'` when undefined. Field omitted entirely if unset.

a4b9f8de17a56af3e9a90753bcdfe9858f9a3a4d.title: Added HY3, HY3 Atlas, Kat Coder Pro V2 models; new session helpers
a4b9f8de17a56af3e9a90753bcdfe9858f9a3a4d.summary: Registered three new free agent models (HY3, HY3 Atlas, Kat Coder Pro V2) in the core constants. Added internal helper functions for session model validation and availability checks, plus a new trusted server-to-server header constant.

bd3b19ed76cf17a16e45df2e329ee5e84b7b6883.title: SDK: Terminal command detachment unified across platforms
bd3b19ed76cf17a16e45df2e329ee5e84b7b6883.summary: Updated `run-terminal-command.ts` to always use `detached: true`. Ensures consistent process group isolation on POSIX and full console detachment on Windows to prevent input stealing.

b01c3662b93cb30efaf48dd1e2581326fc8a31f4.title: Increase Freebuff Web limited project daily limit
b01c3662b93cb30efaf48dd1e2581326fc8a31f4.summary: Raised `FREEBUFF_WEB_LIMITED_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT` from 1 to 3 for outer-region Freebuff Web users.

25bcff7a78ced153e5d55e161619e48ffdb74ddb.title: Add CLI install command copy analytics event
25bcff7a78ced153e5d55e161619e48ffdb74ddb.summary: New `FREEBUFF_CLI_INSTALL_COMMAND_COPIED` analytics event added to track install command copies on the `/cli` landing page, distinguishing hero vs install section via `location`.

af893569c95a1986af346b999206f467f2729e53.title: Ignore .freebuff/ local runtime state
af893569c95a1986af346b999206f467f2729e53.summary: Added `.freebuff/` to `.gitignore` to exclude local runtime state (SQLite DB, git worktrees, built-in skills) from version control.

d0de3f5b1cbd70534b9d6c36f0dfc9c77ae8f92b.title: Add experimental model flag, cloud CTA analytics event
d0de3f5b1cbd70534b9d6c36f0dfc9c77ae8f92b.summary: Added `experimental` boolean to `FreebuffModelOption` interface to mark models under trial, applied to HY3, HY3_ATLAS, and KAT_CODER_PRO_V2. Added `FREEBUFF_CLOUD_CONNECT_REPO_CLICKED` analytics event for cloud landing page CTAs.

9e48fc62b994946fb6f5412439bc458c0c222904.title: Add KAT Coder Pro V2 model; HY3 now premium
9e48fc62b994946fb6f5412439bc458c0c222904.summary: Introduced `KAT Coder Pro V2` as a new coding test model. `HY3` switched from free to premium status. Updated model allowlists and cache configurations.

4afa065433a1f7c99574755052324ab24fc7bd1c.title: Add HY3 models (Web-only)
4afa065433a1f7c99574755052324ab24fc7bd1c.summary: Adds `HY3` (free via OpenRouter) and `HY3 Atlas` (premium via Atlas Cloud) to the model configuration. These are currently restricted to the Freebuff Web interface and excluded from CLI/Desktop surfaces.

0deed0f9ae60e3d338e71d7077fe4180e21277f4.title: Windows terminal watchdog uses plain PowerShell command
0deed0f9ae60e3d338e71d7077fe4180e21277f4.summary: Replaced `-EncodedCommand` with plain `-Command` in Windows terminal watchdog to avoid EDR/AV false positives. Script now passes reset sequences as numeric byte arrays to maintain quoting safety without double quotes.

d0b938bca49fdf28e96d4a4079bcf350946b2f6f.title: Refactor base2 agent prompts and branding
d0b938bca49fdf28e96d4a4079bcf350946b2f6f.summary: Updated system prompts for base2 agent. Renamed 'Codebuff' to 'Freebuff' for free mode. Consolidated editing mandates into general guidelines. Added conditional thinking tags for default/max modes.

05e61796b1e972e04d7ab08ff3ec77fa2d6808ce.title: Fix CLI context token counting failure
05e61796b1e972e04d7ab08ff3ec77fa2d6808ce.summary: Pass `apiKey` directly to `callTokenCountAPI` to prevent failures when `CODEBUFF_API_KEY` is missing from the environment. This ensures accurate remote token counting instead of falling back to local estimation.

0a6df5765585fe3da17d92272fbce28be74bc127.title: Inline ads in chat responses
0a6df5765585fe3da17d92272fbce28be74bc127.summary: Ads now appear inside assistant responses, not just above the input. Impression tracking moved to `AdCard`.

f0d966458519ffa59de0fbce27fad27f0ac7a047.title: Remove freebuff/runner package
f0d966458519ffa59de0fbce27fad27f0ac7a047.summary: Deleted `freebuff/runner` directory, including `README.md`, `package.json`, and source files like `convexBridge.ts` and `eventBatcher.ts`. This removes the standalone Render-hosted agent runner implementation from the repository.

304f8c16ed581066ab94ad28f4f3d6ab3642865f.title: Free agent skips code-reviewer when noReview set
304f8c16ed581066ab94ad28f4f3d6ab3642865f.summary: Free-tier agent instructions now conditionally omit code-reviewer spawning and fixing steps when `noReview` is true, preserving typecheck and test execution.

fd36250a7af2416544869fa2694916edfd81b6d2.title: Map SDK to source in runner tsconfig
fd36250a7af2416544869fa2694916edfd81b6d2.summary: Added `@codebuff/sdk` path mapping to `../../sdk/src/index.ts` in `freebuff/runner/tsconfig.json`. This allows `runner` typechecking to succeed without a prior SDK build, matching `cli` behavior.

07ab1c6445e0e36697f749f10d34eccea254b5e5.title: Runner ships lifecycle logs to Axiom
07ab1c6445e0e36697f749f10d34eccea254b5e5.summary: Added `freebuff/runner/src/logger.ts` to standardize logging. Runner now ships lifecycle, claim, and crash logs to the unified `freebuff` Axiom dataset. New `AXIOM_*` env vars required for configuration.

e40725574901bc9196b956db9113351627654769.title: Remove legacy MiniMax M2.7, default free agents to M3
e40725574901bc9196b956db9113351627654769.summary: Free and Lite modes now use MiniMax M3. Legacy M2.7 agents, models, and 200k context pruners removed.

778ce13d412dcf87de7eec8b2732d27aa9c35c3a.title: Improve token counting for agent context
778ce13d412dcf87de7eec8b2732d27aa9c35c3a.summary: Switched to structured message token counting to avoid inflating estimates with JSON scaffolding and base64 image data. Added flat cost estimates for media files and per-message overhead to better align local counts with model billing.

f7828c2c4b5a55de46b00f0484ed047e091d0964.title: Freebuff Runner worker added
f7828c2c4b5a55de46b00f0484ed047e091d0964.summary: New Bun worker offloads agent execution from Convex actions. Feature flag `freebuff_runner_enabled` defaults ON. Deploy worker before Convex push to avoid stuck queues.

48803a249a48035e7f3c3041d5f704b233720a4c.title: Fix Windows terminal input stealing via windowsHide
48803a249a48035e7f3c3041d5f704b233720a4c.summary: Set `windowsHide: true` for terminal commands on Windows. Prevents child processes from attaching to the TUI console and stealing VT input.

dc8f236d73ec651b392b4dbb09a8826258f12666.title: Add Reddit Conversions API integration and retention tracking
dc8f236d73ec651b392b4dbb09a8826258f12666.summary: Added server-side Reddit Conversions API support for custom events (First Prompt, Retention) to improve ad attribution. New utilities handle event name mapping, user identity hashing, and retention milestone calculation.

c59bde7fe2f90f0e25b0ce36a1d8856ec8ccfa5f.title: CLI: Inline Ads in Chat Transcript
c59bde7fe2f90f0e25b0ce36a1d8856ec8ccfa5f.summary: Replaced the static ad banner with inline ads anchored below completed AI responses. Ads now appear within the chat scrollback, spaced every few exchanges.

2a0165cd6654c96138ebf48279da6271d3edb8d9.title: Fix JSON schema type coercion in agent runtime
2a0165cd6654c96138ebf48279da6271d3edb8d9.summary: Corrected `toTokenCountInputSchema` to treat null and empty string `type` fields as absent, ensuring proper `type: 'object'` backfill for Anthropic compatibility.

5ab9f24e10c3cafc301fe1eb3838c0c54008806f.title: Fix Anthropic token count API rejection for union/complex tool schemas
5ab9f24e10c3cafc301fe1eb3838c0c54008806f.summary: Added `toTokenCountInputSchema` to convert Zod schemas to JSON Schema before sending to Anthropic's `count_tokens` API. Ensures top-level `type: 'object'` is present, preventing API rejections for tools with union or complex input schemas.

04d67d73b9052e63dead5ad1a6cf6bbe76c4cd2e.title: Kimi model removed from default list
04d67d73b9052e63dead5ad1a6cf6bbe76c4cd2e.summary: The `KIMI_MODEL` constant was removed from the `FREEBUFF_MODELS` array in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. This change prevents the model from appearing in the default model selection list.

fe1d484e63713352e7fa5bbc033a1171fbed39c7.title: CLI: chat history and trace writer accept dataDir injection
fe1d484e63713352e7fa5bbc033a1171fbed39c7.summary: getAllChats, trimOversizedChatLogs, deleteChatSession now take optional dataDir. createTraceWriter takes optional resolveTraceFilePath. Internal plumbing for multi-dir support.

30819406bcc40a132d363f3ac2bceb285ad06031.title: CLI prompt builders & router accept injectable ChatGPT auth status
30819406bcc40a132d363f3ac2bceb285ad06031.summary: Refactored `prompt-builders.ts` to allow injecting `isChatGptConnected` callbacks into plan/review prompt functions, replacing direct `getChatGptOAuthStatus` calls. Updated `router.ts` to accept an injectable `exchangeChatGptAuthCode` function. Internal changes only.

10ec4e5ad003a6c5bd72ba98ad322469581d3d69.title: SDK tools access paths outside project
10ec4e5ad003a6c5bd72ba98ad322469581d3d69.summary: New `resolveFilePath` replaces project-restricted path resolution in `apply-patch`, `change-file`, `code-search`, `list-directory`, and `read-files`. Tools now accept absolute or external relative paths. Gitignore checks skipped for files outside project.

f8b3b17b3ed642b2fb5d7bea14d33db9aa340651.title: Rename Waiting Room to Freebuff Landing Screen
f8b3b17b3ed642b2fb5d7bea14d33db9aa340651.summary: Renamed `WaitingRoomScreen` to `FreebuffLandingScreen`. Internal refactor; no user-visible behavior changes.

bd166f455bc3bee08e35e0cc212e4da6fbbe4f15.title: Better handling of transient network errors
bd166f455bc3bee08e35e0cc212e4da6fbbe4f15.summary: Detects transient network errors (ECONNRESET, fetch failed) and shows a user-friendly message instead of a raw stack trace. Wraps fetch to mark these errors as retryable for the AI SDK, enabling automatic retries on brief connection drops.
