3d1a8e68f275183a92cfbb5100a2528bd5ce4c79.title: CLI: terminal watchdog, kitty/modifyOtherKeys reset
3d1a8e68f275183a92cfbb5100a2528bd5ce4c79.summary: Added `terminal-watchdog.ts` and `terminal-reset-sequences.ts`. New detached `/bin/sh` watchdog resets terminal on uncatchable exits (SIGKILL, group kill). Reset sequences now include `[<u` (kitty keyboard protocol pop) and `[>4;0m` (modifyOtherKeys reset). Watchdog killed synchronously on clean shutdown. Windows unaffected.

7f595c4c0634c855c18f0cfb325c173392e3bd61.title: Waiting-room queue removed. Sessions admitted instantly.
7f595c4c0634c855c18f0cfb325c173392e3bd61.summary: Freebuff sessions now start immediately without a waiting room queue. Error messages updated to reflect instant admission. Legacy wire codes retained for compatibility.

030a4c60e51b5da6ad04a6ac3e3470a7ce53b874.title: Add chat ads experiment analytics events
030a4c60e51b5da6ad04a6ac3e3470a7ce53b874.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CHAT_ADS_EXPERIMENT_EXPOSED` and `FREEBUFF_CHAT_ADS_AD_SHOWN` to support server-rendered Gravity ads experiment tracking in web chat.

8151087175d6205542190ed092126bdd19ae4130.title: Freebuff CLI: hold queued messages when session ends
8151087175d6205542190ed092126bdd19ae4130.summary: Messages are now requeued at the head of the queue when a Freebuff session ends before processing, preventing silent drops. Inline errors inform users to resend after starting a new session.

f65992d39adda73162606b55c07b364ca8afa181.title: Add 20s timeout to CLI session API calls
f65992d39adda73162606b55c07b364ca8afa181.summary: Session API requests now abort after 20 seconds. Prevents the CLI from hanging indefinitely on dead connections or overloaded servers.

85ccc41bab5e0ee15d2cd97f2230055f4f2984b2.title: Shared slot logic for limited tier
85ccc41bab5e0ee15d2cd97f2230055f4f2984b2.summary: Added `occupiesFreebuffDesktopSlot` to unify server/client concurrency checks. Limited-tier users now restricted to one desktop tab regardless of model. `premium_slot_taken` response includes `reason` field for clearer UI messaging.

e8a95a27ac79ae26a56a5fa8d8e9904471ec4423.title: Skip token-count API in free mode
e8a95a27ac79ae26a56a5fa8d8e9904471ec4423.summary: Free mode now uses local token counting instead of the web API. Reduces per-step latency and server load.

cee618d4b5a9d00053d9955262595b276fd7ea1e.title: CLI: Hold queued messages when free session ends
cee618d4b5a9d00053d9955262595b276fd7ea1e.summary: Queued messages are now held instead of being dispatched after the free session hard cutoff. This prevents server rejections for pending tasks; the queue automatically resumes when the user rejoins a session.

22aa19aade611c31aff555cc55f280c653910fe7.title: SDK: Refactor runtime app URL resolution
22aa19aade611c31aff555cc55f280c653910fe7.summary: Extracted runtime app URL resolution logic from `constants.ts` to `env.ts` in `getRuntimeAppUrlFromEnv`. `getWebsiteUrl` now uses this helper. Internal refactor for consistency.

4ea700cd6ebb12e204b37095f477a2e8fd5955b5.title: Added desktop queue send-now analytics event
4ea700cd6ebb12e204b37095f477a2e8fd5955b5.summary: Added new `DESKTOP_QUEUE_SEND_NOW` constant to analytics events enum. Enables tracking of immediate message dispatch from the desktop queue.

671c093077dc5cd74ab2b1892c7c134d84c8fbd8.title: Full chat history preserved. /history loads faster.
671c093077dc5cd74ab2b1892c7c134d84c8fbd8.summary: CLI no longer trims saved transcripts to 100 messages, keeping full history in `chat-messages.json`. New sidecar `chat-meta.json` stores summaries so `/history` loads without parsing large files.

4f5a72d6b85c9521b28248e359c11719cf6d55c4.title: Add shared log serialization util, update analytics docs
4f5a72d6b85c9521b28248e359c11719cf6d55c4.summary: Added `common/src/util/log-data.ts` with `serializeLogData` and `LOG_LEVEL_ORDER` to standardize Axiom log ingestion across services. Updated `MESSAGE_SENT` analytics comments to include `cloud` surface and clarify emission points.

77cfee986c1b3e6fd7fffc5b37bb7c4028a30446.title: SDK: Add AbortSignal Support to Tools
77cfee986c1b3e6fd7fffc5b37bb7c4028a30446.summary: SDK tools (`run_terminal_command`, `code_search`, `read_url`) now accept an `AbortSignal` to allow user-initiated cancellation. Process groups are killed on abort to prevent zombie processes.

a07d73d1f0bdd5f9c47d64423d3837d59bcb2309.title: SDK resolves backend URL at runtime
a07d73d1f0bdd5f9c47d64423d3837d59bcb2309.summary: SDK now resolves the Codebuff backend base URL at call time via `getWebsiteUrl()` instead of relying solely on the bundle-time `WEBSITE_URL` constant. Deployment `process.env` values for `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` or `CODEBUFF_APP_URL` take precedence, fixing unreachable localhost URLs in remote runtimes like Convex or Next server routes. `WEBSITE_URL` is deprecated.

effaebabd70b475f18cd90481cc6cbc88c5ff9e3.title: CLI: In-flight chat state persistence and restoration
effaebabd70b475f18cd90481cc6cbc88c5ff9e3.summary: Added live chat state checkpointing to prevent data loss on terminal close or crash. Restored chat states now sanitize messages and handle partial file corruption independently.

e6af6ff08ba0ed02b362aae22b208e554fd5f74a.title: Fix agent step execution for bundled code
e6af6ff08ba0ed02b362aae22b208e554fd5f74a.summary: Preserves live `handleSteps` functions alongside serialized strings to prevent runtime `ReferenceError`s caused by bundler artifacts (e.g. esbuild `__name`). Improves error diagnostics when eval fails.

bfaad48713d14b4e948a6ad49a2c6f79d6cb250c.title: Add analytics events for referral failure and sock-puppet signals
bfaad48713d14b4e948a6ad49a2c6f79d6cb250c.summary: Introduced `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_REDEEM_FAILED` to track eligibility guard rejections for support diagnosis. Added `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SOCK_SIGNAL` to flag referrals from IPs/browsers recently seen by the referrer.

d304465cf1503c0d27dc79e6ffaf252657fe922c.title: Add desktop ad analytics events
d304465cf1503c0d27dc79e6ffaf252657fe922c.summary: Added `DESKTOP_AD_SHOWN` and `DESKTOP_AD_CLICKED` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum to track sponsored ad impressions and clicks on the desktop surface.

b88380a4c48c5a1dfe12d788f62d794c5df7db57.title: Fix chat corruption, atomic writes, unreadable history handling
b88380a4c48c5a1dfe12d788f62d794c5df7db57.summary: Implemented atomic file writes for chat state to prevent truncation during crashes. Updated history screen to display unreadable/corrupted chats with option to delete, preventing silent data loss. Rotated chat IDs on new sessions to avoid overwriting resumed history.

55f61ffc60b73ecdfb31f8d649e85e4ff3086c0b.title: Limited-tier users now see daily session bonus referral banner
55f61ffc60b73ecdfb31f8d649e85e4ff3086c0b.summary: The CLI referral banner now supports limited-tier users, advertising a daily free-session bonus instead of hiding the perk. Full-tier users continue to see the GLM 5.2 unlock card. The `FreebuffReferralInfo` type updated to make GLM-specific fields optional for limited-tier responses.

122933fd79cf8b99c6346050f96fc8dc56649141.title: CLI: Centralize Freebuff web host constant
122933fd79cf8b99c6346050f96fc8dc56649141.summary: Added `common/src/constants/hosts.ts` with `FREEBUFF_WEB_URL_PROD`. CLI login flow now imports this shared constant instead of hardcoding the fallback URL. No user-facing behavior change.

b10e9ab1644601375492fa771f2acd2088b27429.title: Fix tool-call replay for reasoning models
b10e9ab1644601375492fa771f2acd2088b27429.summary: Merge adjacent assistant messages containing reasoning_content and tool_calls into single wire message. Fixes validation errors in models like DeepSeek V4 requiring reasoning on same message as tool calls.

b5b0f9c223124e9746e9faa8d3d5e96978262dc9.title: Bump freebuff version to 0.0.116
b5b0f9c223124e9746e9faa8d3d5e96978262dc9.summary: Version incremented from 0.0.115 to 0.0.116 in package.json.

f67bb803bda67f875fd14647d3f3458e56e732fb.title: Refactor handleSteps deserialization in Agent Runtime
f67bb803bda67f875fd14647d3f3458e56e732fb.summary: Extracted `eval` usage into a dedicated `deserializeHandleSteps` helper function. Improved code formatting and error message construction in `runProgrammaticStep`.

03843a6a7999022e6a7cb133ae6a3d5e8bd851f5.title: Add referral signup window and max limit constants
03843a6a7999022e6a7cb133ae6a3d5e8bd851f5.summary: Introduced `REFERRAL_SIGNUP_WINDOW_DAYS` (30) and `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SIGNUP_LIMIT` (100) to `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts`. These constants enforce attribution time limits and anti-spam ceilings for the referral_v2 path.

e90202304629a44f84287728ac07d150354508a2.title: Reorder Minimax M3 to top of Freebuff model list
e90202304629a44f84287728ac07d150354508a2.summary: Moved `MINIMAX_M3_MODEL` to the first position in `FREEBUFF_MODELS`. This changes the default model selection order for users.

6937a4a1d869a5d878d178a2c3b57d4ae6f75562.title: Add DESKTOP_THREAD_TITLED analytics event
6937a4a1d869a5d878d178a2c3b57d4ae6f75562.summary: Added `DESKTOP_THREAD_TITLED` enum value to `AnalyticsEvent` in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` to track desktop thread titling actions.

b4989d0c77187ca908ff2417b1dfd4e68be25818.title: Fix GLM referral banner overlap in CLI
b4989d0c77187ca908ff2417b1dfd4e68be25818.summary: Prevent referral banner from squashing and overlapping UI elements in the CLI waiting room. Adjusted row reservation logic and flex properties for accurate height calculation.

79127c26ba4d555c14ad85e5f16539447f4a81b8.title: Add freebuff-desktop-thread agent ID, allow full desktop model set
79127c26ba4d555c14ad85e5f16539447f4a81b8.summary: New constant `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_THREAD_AGENT_ID` ('freebuff-desktop-thread') registered as first-party free-mode root. Desktop uses single root ID for all models, unlike CLI per-model roots. Allowlist grants access to full desktop picker set: MiniMax M3, DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash, Kimi, Mimo V25 Pro/Standard. Concurrency remains bounded by existing free-session admission gate.

0eb5e08fac20277f02c9f486b6176610e73431da.title: Daily project cap for limited-tier Freebuff Web
0eb5e08fac20277f02c9f486b6176610e73431da.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_WEB_LIMITED_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT` (1). Outer-region users restricted to one project creation per day, resetting at midnight Pacific time.

f1a5a202b3505df7216651ab21560dd053faf148.title: CLI selects baseline binary on Windows CPUs without AVX2
f1a5a202b3505df7216651ab21560dd053faf148.summary: Windows installs now detect AVX2 support via PowerShell before selecting the binary, preventing SIGILL crashes on older CPUs. Results are cached to `cpu-features.json`. Crash diagnostics now suggest `FREEBUFF_BINARY_TARGET` for manual fallback.

1576d8cceceddde2310b475e1dbe0f0f0add67d5.title: Referral eligibility: GitHub age requirement lowered to 4 months
1576d8cceceddde2310b475e1dbe0f0f0add67d5.summary: Unified referral system now requires 4 months GitHub account age for all products, down from 12 months.

92a719efa08071eb2c6f0eb67079416304201adb.title: Add desktop analytics events and sampling
92a719efa08071eb2c6f0eb67079416304201adb.summary: New `desktop.*` analytics events added to constants. These events bypass sampling in `analytics-sampling.ts` to ensure accurate funnel tracking.

3f6c218fcf769874ed0dbdd7ffac50e3294db19e.title: CLI: Handle premium_slot_taken state
3f6c218fcf769874ed0dbdd7ffac50e3294db19e.summary: Added `premium_slot_taken` to `nextDelayMs` in `use-freebuff-session.ts` to return `null`, preventing retries for this state.

90210bb6a19dd9ee6bdc4f322668619399caa166.title: Add accessTier to CLI message analytics
90210bb6a19dd9ee6bdc4f322668619399caa166.summary: CLI analytics now include `accessTier` from the Freebuff session state when tracking message events. Defaults to 'unknown' if session data is missing.

c7df706d4a2306da3d645b3d5091a718f0b057bc.title: Show streak perk note at 7+ days
c7df706d4a2306da3d645b3d5091a718f0b057bc.summary: New UI note under model picker for 7+ day streaks. Explains recurring weekly bonus. GLM mention gated by active referral program.

454dcd2c72790576154d4ed6cc68d96bf47dad96.title: Steering hook for running agent
454dcd2c72790576154d4ed6cc68d96bf47dad96.summary: Added optional `drainSteeringMessages` to `run-agent-step.ts` and SDK `RunOptions`. Hosts can inject user messages into a running agent at step boundaries without aborting.

2cb4fc339e109217ef4fba773241100ee66680f0.title: Unified 12mo GitHub age bar; CLI referral daily bonus cap
2cb4fc339e109217ef4fba773241100ee66680f0.summary: Consolidated referral eligibility to a single 12-month GitHub account age requirement across all products, removing the previous per-program distinctions. Added a cap on the daily free-mode session bonus granted by limited-tier CLI referrals.

15c9fe6c7e7bff8436ca2e3f48cb699de7d56c55.title: Desktop premium concurrency cap & multi-session headers
15c9fe6c7e7bff8436ca2e3f48cb699de7d56c55.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_PREMIUM_BUCKET_MODEL_IDS` to enforce a single concurrent premium session for desktop multi-session mode. Introduced shared wire headers (`x-freebuff-instance-id`, `x-freebuff-model`, `x-freebuff-multi-session`) and a `premium_slot_taken` server response type for handling concurrency conflicts.

9e61e4b90860c77829c87b675c5a7f002276ef9d.title: MCP server errors now show command and stderr
9e61e4b90860c77829c87b675c5a7f002276ef9d.summary: Failed MCP stdio server startups now include the command, environment hints, and captured stderr in the error message. A crashing MCP server disables only its own tools instead of aborting the agent turn.

a60a6abccdfcbbe6d3a72c17ed86dbc03810876a.title: Tab completes slash commands; streak bonus sessions added
a60a6abccdfcbbe6d3a72c17ed86dbc03810876a.summary: Tab in slash menu now completes highlighted command without navigating. Streak rewards grant bonus sessions every 7 days.

a64b9c03fd75cad359bf64f3c82b1bc7651a2bc4.title: Add referral lifecycle analytics events
a64b9c03fd75cad359bf64f3c82b1bc7651a2bc4.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_REDEEMED`, `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_COMPLETED`, and `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_SWEEP` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum. These track server-side referral program transitions and aggregated sweep outcomes.

425e9cb485d05a34b93c2abdf22a8e980fc2effb.title: Add chat title generation analytics event
425e9cb485d05a34b93c2abdf22a8e980fc2effb.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CHAT_TITLE_GENERATED` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum. Tracks server-side chat title generation attempts, capturing outcome, latency, model, and title length for failure and fallback analysis.

6e063e113c757309a151e1c78b52ebca7a12c0e6.title: Add ipinfo ASN type helpers for privacy checks
6e063e113c757309a151e1c78b52ebca7a12c0e6.summary: Added `isFreebuffBenignAsType` and `isFreebuffHostingAsType` helpers to classify ipinfo ASN types. This distinguishes benign networks (ISP, business, etc.) from hosting infrastructure for abuse detection.

8a96d48d79d02c951416f047ba4d2b269407b584.title: CLI engaged-time heartbeat
8a96d48d79d02c951416f047ba4d2b269407b584.summary: CLI tracks active minutes via `PRODUCT_ACTIVE_MINUTE` events. Heartbeat starts on TUI launch, stops on exit. New `engagement-tracker` utility added.

ca8ddb859a773965c2058c74e401c818650f92d9.title: Removed waiting room queue state from CLI
ca8ddb859a773965c2058c74e401c818650f92d9.summary: Deleted 'queued' session status handling. Users now transition directly from model selection to active chat or terminal states. Removed waiting room UI components and position tracking.

ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.title: Add /copy command to export conversation to clipboard
ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.summary: New `/copy` command serializes the full chat history (text, reasoning, tool calls, sub-agents) into Markdown and copies it to the system clipboard. Handles large transcripts over SSH by automatically truncating tool outputs to fit OSC 52 limits.

5824dc1d4e6d9948220ac83e68c0254f775f08c7.title: E2E boot signal detection
5824dc1d4e6d9948220ac83e68c0254f775f08c7.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_BOOT_SIGNALS` constant and `waitForBootSignal` method to `FreebuffSession`. Polls tmux output for multiple known boot-screen markers instead of relying on a single ASCII logo line, improving CI reliability.

b3c3decd0afb7d08f0ab70a80070a316c1547bab.title: Agents discover/install skills; skill loads from disk
b3c3decd0afb7d08f0ab70a80070a316c1547bab.summary: Base agent instructs on `npx skills find/add` for community skills (`.agents/skills/`) with user confirm. `skill` tool now always reads fresh from disk, falling back to session-start cache. Updated `skill` tool description.

dd3e1e6aa9ef1bd11f446bb4cca0ceaf1ac3e89b.title: CLI referral banner text wrapping and layout fixes
dd3e1e6aa9ef1bd11f446bb4cca0ceaf1ac3e89b.summary: Fixes referral banner layout issues in the CLI. The 'Copy Invite Link' button now prevents shrinking, and banner text wraps by word instead of clipping.

ae4bfa7060da887ef37210aa0d5c33adad14963d.title: Add streak progress dots, referral caps to CLI
ae4bfa7060da887ef37210aa0d5c33adad14963d.summary: New `freebuff-streak-line.ts` util displays `N day streak` with weekly progress dots. Referral banner now shows `qualifiedCount/cap` and dynamic invite labels. Layout spacing adjusted for wrapped referral text.

d1fb7fdf239e8a306f7d31a19fd4de4fa4ab58e0.title: Chat agent suggests followups after every reply
d1fb7fdf239e8a306f7d31a19fd4de4fa4ab58e0.summary: Added suggest_followups tool to base-chat agent. System prompt instructs agent to end responses with 3 specific followup suggestions for user.

82827cafd83ff35bc18530e2729ccf86ee4497f4.title: Version bump to 0.0.114
82827cafd83ff35bc18530e2729ccf86ee4497f4.summary: Updated package version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.113 to 0.0.114.

c0d984a61fa18c7fdb06b8132b63d3134abf5816.title: Fix GLM banner visibility, streak dots, and session persistence
c0d984a61fa18c7fdb06b8132b63d3134abf5816.summary: GLM referral banner now persists across session states using a new cache. Streak progress dots stay full after reaching 7 days instead of rolling over. Fixed invisible text on focused buttons and refined hover/focus styles.

6e8e17d890d006bf4ee5a2545d18ed9fac02f01e.title: Add referral onboarding funnel analytics events
6e8e17d890d006bf4ee5a2545d18ed9fac02f01e.summary: Introduced seven new analytics events to track the user journey from viewing the Get Started page through sign-in, eligibility resolution, and installation. Added `referrer` property to all events for per-referrer funnel analysis. Deprecated two previous events (`HELP_EXPANDED`, `EDITOR_CLICKED`). Bumped CLI version to 0.0.113.

7f4effcaa955faf0576cdffb799998fd36733bbe.title: UI: Referral text simplified; streak placement & >7d indicator
7f4effcaa955faf0576cdffb799998fd36733bbe.summary: Referral banner text shortened. Streak display now inline on wide landing screens, separate line on narrow/queued. Streaks >7 days show trailing '+' in progress dots.

979954f98423e67c331525052c100358fa1f97a4.title: Add login funnel analytics to CLI
979954f98423e67c331525052c100358fa1f97a4.summary: Added new analytics events (`cli.login_started`, `cli.login_failed`, `cli.login_timeout`, `cli.login_aborted`) to track the login process from start to finish. These events are tagged with a `via` property to distinguish between modal sign-ins and the `login` command. This change is internal for users but provides valuable data for contributors.

ec42536f50943a38138d63621738bf4a4e5bfa8f.title: Improve referral banner UX
ec42536f50943a38138d63621738bf4a4e5bfa8f.summary: Referral banner now uses a dedicated copy button with visual feedback and links to the get-started page with referrer personalization. Banner is hidden for limited-tier users. Layout adjusted in waiting room.

eebd6089f2b07ee217e4367ccdf074effed29364.title: Keyboard navigation for referral banner buttons
eebd6089f2b07ee217e4367ccdf074effed29364.summary: Referral banner buttons (copy link, use GLM) are now keyboard-focusable via the model selector. Arrowing down past "see all models" reaches these controls, and Enter activates them. Copy state logic was lifted into a shared hook.

1bac5606860ccd893adeb9188103fde0d2bb93f6.title: Add GLM 5.2 referral unlock and agents
1bac5606860ccd893adeb9188103fde0d2bb93f6.summary: New GLM 5.2 orchestrator and code-reviewer agents. CLI adds referral banner to unlock GLM 5.2 by inviting friends, hiding it from standard model picker.

43301d5fd2bcb9bdf1e0f3fc26a14de115359d84.title: Add Reddit ad funnel analytics events
43301d5fd2bcb9bdf1e0f3fc26a14de115359d84.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_ATTRIBUTED` and `FREEBUFF_REDDIT_FUNNEL_*` events to `AnalyticsEvent` enum to track acquisition attribution and Reddit ad funnel steps.

3e442f817a080ee0f2ac2ecd86193db9e2c7349f.title: CLI analytics: persistent anonymous id, login funnel fixes
3e442f817a080ee0f2ac2ecd86193db9e2c7349f.summary: Anonymous id persists across launches so pre-login events alias correctly. Session restore and plain login now emit login events. Config dir extracted to avoid import cycles.

750dc9aaa60a81d5716bfe47380a859dd7159720.title: Remove ChatGPT connection gate for /plan and /review
750dc9aaa60a81d5716bfe47380a859dd7159720.summary: /plan and /review commands no longer require a connected ChatGPT account. They now run on the selected model by default, delegating to GPT only if connected.

0b97b6efd524e5044a6c7b31e20a7a748326feff.title: Version bump to 0.0.112
0b97b6efd524e5044a6c7b31e20a7a748326feff.summary: Updated `freebuff` package version from 0.0.111 to 0.0.112 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.

4c9007c7eaa0c04135f1be020c5209621d5aa716.title: Fix Gravity attribution for Freebuff Web shared accounts
4c9007c7eaa0c04135f1be020c5209621d5aa716.summary: Added `external_user_id` to Gravity index schema to attribute conversions to end users on shared service-account surfaces like Freebuff Web. Agent runtime now detects `freebuff_web` and `freebuff_chat` surfaces and forwards stable fingerprint IDs instead of collapsing traffic onto the service account.

4d7555cb6f9415176119010fabe5c27f13d8243b.title: Gemini Pro gate + dated-model suffix matching
4d7555cb6f9415176119010fabe5c27f13d8243b.summary: Added `isFreebuffGeminiProAgent` gate restricting Gemini Pro calls to CLI and chat thinker subagents. Introduced `freebuffModelIdMatches` to tolerate dated provider suffixes in model ID checks, preventing bypass of premium rate caps and Gemini gates via dated variants.

95a1156a6015112ed1b82cb897df77395b0fd5b0.title: Press Enter cue on focused recommended model
95a1156a6015112ed1b82cb897df77395b0fd5b0.summary: Adds right-aligned "Press Enter ↵" text to focused recommended model row in CLI selector. Improves button affordance visibility.

692bf102f5e653d85d43fc32883c4d8366c537ef.title: Consolidate Freebuff docs, update model list, clarify limited mode
692bf102f5e653d85d43fc32883c4d8366c537ef.summary: Moved Freebuff documentation to root README.md as single source of truth. Updated supported models to include Kimi, MiniMax, and MiMo. Clarified 'limited mode' availability for non-full-access regions and VPN users. Removed ChatGPT integration references.

538768ba9aaf73180427a125c12e05edf67fbbd6.title: CLI: Show premium quota and reset countdown always
538768ba9aaf73180427a125c12e05edf67fbbd6.summary: The CLI model selector now displays the premium session quota and daily reset countdown from the start, even at "0 of M". Previously, this information was hidden until at least one session was used.

feb051debac2365daf253d424385b6c6e57ec64a.title: Bump Bun runtime to 1.3.14
feb051debac2365daf253d424385b6c6e57ec64a.summary: Updated Bun version in `.bun-version`, `package.json` engines, and `packageManager` fields from 1.3.11 to 1.3.14.

637bdf14fa0443c9539f6550eeb64ae129fb55c6.title: Add MESSAGE_SENT analytics event for DAU tracking
637bdf14fa0443c9539f6550eeb64ae129fb55c6.summary: Introduced `MESSAGE_SENT` event to track Daily Active Users (DAU) across CLI, web, and chat surfaces. This event is always tracked (never sampled) and includes metadata such as surface, mode, and input characteristics.

2e94bb23cc19832c25dad3b04883f71a44fdd998.title: Model picker: premium quota inline in header, below-picker counter limited-tier only
2e94bb23cc19832c25dad3b04883f71a44fdd998.summary: Premium session usage (`N of M used`) and reset countdown now render on the `PREMIUM` section header inside the model picker, replacing the below-picker counter for regular tiers. The below-picker counter remains only for `limited`-tier users, since their picker has no premium section. Reset countdown now appears as soon as any session is spent, not only when the quota is exhausted.

de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.title: Increased daily model limits for all referral tiers
de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.summary: Daily usage limits for standard and premium models have been raised across all referral tiers. For example, Tier 0 now allows 24 standard and 4 premium requests per day, while Tier 3 allows 110 standard and 15 premium requests.

b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.title: Waiting room shows full ASCII logo when model picker collapsed
b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.summary: The waiting-room screen now promotes the compact wordmark to the full ASCII logo when the model picker is collapsed, filling freed vertical space on mid-height terminals (≥26 rows). Expanding the list reclaims those rows and reverts to the wordmark.

edacbeb3609c311a58aac127c5264255149302df.title: Rebrand Manicode to Freebuff
edacbeb3609c311a58aac127c5264255149302df.summary: License copyright updated to Freebuff, Inc. Eval fixtures corrected to match new branding and backend URLs.

59f2ba13cee05f37282e74d3738adfe15633ef31.title: Smoke binary boot retry
59f2ba13cee05f37282e74d3738adfe15633ef31.summary: Added retry logic to CLI smoke binary boot test to handle transient Windows CI hangs. Fatal errors still fail immediately.

a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.title: Anonymous CLI log shipping, rate limit util
a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.summary: CLI now ships logs to `/api/logs` without auth. Analytics events mirror to Axiom logs sink. Added shared `log-mirror` and `rate-limit` utilities.

a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.title: Lite agent defaults to MiniMax M3 instead of DeepSeek V4 Flash
a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.summary: Updated `base2` agent configuration. Lite mode now routes to MiniMax M3 via Fireworks AI, replacing DeepSeek V4 Flash. Internal model constants adjusted.

bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.title: CLI 1.0.682: Add onboarding suggested prompts
bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.summary: Added clickable starter prompts for new Freebuff users. Prompts disappear after first message submission.

a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.title: Model picker defaults to recommended hero
a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.summary: Collapsed view shows recommended model. Expanded view reveals all tiers.

cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.title: Show onboarding prompts above status bar
cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.summary: Onboarding prompts now appear above the status bar. They are hidden during review mode or if the session is over.

7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.title: Gemini thinker: broader trigger, more parent models
7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.summary: Gemini thinker spawn prompts now trigger on non-trivial bugs and uncertain approaches, not just the hardest tasks. Two more models added to the allowed parent list.

ed764c4f8db46d834c0b0f04883fee15b35c4c55.title: CLI smoke test accepts OpenTUI terminal handshakes as boot signals
ed764c4f8db46d834c0b0f04883fee15b35c4c55.summary: Added ANSI escape codes for alternate screen and Kitty keyboard protocol to `BOOT_SIGNAL_PATTERNS` in `cli/scripts/smoke-binary.ts`. Prevents smoke test failures on Windows CI when static React text doesn't flush before timeout.

d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.title: Chat delegates reasoning to Gemini; SDK fixes agent attribution
d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.summary: Freebuff Chat now automatically spawns the `thinker-gemini` agent for complex reasoning tasks instead of handling them internally. The `thinker-gemini` agent's reasoning effort increased to 'medium' and it gained a display name. The SDK and agent runtime now correctly attribute streaming reasoning deltas to the specific sub-agent ID rather than the run ID, fixing consumer mapping issues.

f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.title: CLI logs mirror to server sink
f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.summary: CLI now ships logs and analytics events to the `/api/logs` Axiom sink via a new batched, best-effort shipper. Controlled by `CODEBUFF_SHIP_LOGS` (on by default outside dev/test/CI), with new shared schemas, contracts, and ingest helpers.

ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.title: Clarify geo-gated premium model limits for referral tiers
ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.summary: Updated documentation in `freebuff-referral-tiers.ts` to clarify that premium model limits remain geo-gated in limited regions, even if tiers are unlocked.

f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.title: Gravity surface attribution uses existing metadata
f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.summary: Updated `gravitySurface` logic to prioritize `surface` from existing metadata over default template-based values. This ensures more accurate attribution for clicks and conversions when context is already present.

370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.title: Referral tiers and watermark removal
370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.summary: New referral system for web signups. Tiers unlock higher daily model limits and remove deploy watermark. Requires 4-month-old GitHub accounts for qualified referrals.

7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.title: Simplify Gravity Surface Attribution
7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.summary: Refactored `gravitySurface` in `gravity-index.ts`. Removed logic checking `existingMetadata.surface`, forcing derivation solely from `agentTemplate.id`. Reduces code complexity in Agent Runtime.

874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.title: Add Kimi K2.7 Code agent and model support
874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.summary: New agent `base2-kimi-2-7-code` added. Model `moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code` supported in agent definitions and model config. Eval runner updated to use new agent.

957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.title: CLI: Fix WSL browser open crash
957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.summary: Added WSL detection and `powershell.exe` existence check to `safeOpen` to prevent uncaught exceptions when Windows interop is disabled. Also attached error listener to subprocess to catch delayed spawn failures.

8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.title: CLI: Model picker shows premium reset countdown, country names in notices
8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.summary: Premium model section headers now display a reset countdown when the daily quota is exhausted. Limited-mode notices show full country names (e.g., 'Brazil' instead of 'BR') and are hidden in compact terminals. Status lines (counter, notice, streak) moved below the model picker.

e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.title: Replace Claude Fable 5 with Opus 4.8 in Max mode agents
e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.summary: Max mode now uses `anthropic/claude-opus-4.8` for base agent, best-of-n selector, multi-prompt editor, and code reviewer. Fable model variants removed from internal agent definitions.

9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.title: Freebuff Chat gains gravity_index tool
9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.summary: The `base-chat` agent now has access to the `gravity_index` tool, allowing it to recommend third-party developer services. Attribution for these recommendations is now correctly segmented between `freebuff_chat` and `codebuff_cli` surfaces.

778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.title: Prevent code reviewer spawn when no code changes
778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.summary: Updated `buildImplementationStepPrompt` in `agents/base2/base2.ts` to instruct the agent not to spawn a code reviewer if no code changes were made (e.g., plan-only or Q&A responses).

ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.title: Fix memory leaks in agent runtime and SDK cache
ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.summary: Added `clearProgrammaticRunState` to release generator, STEP_ALL flag, and proposed file content on abort/error exits. Implemented bounded FIFO eviction for `databaseAgentCache` in SDK to prevent unbounded growth in long-lived processes.

9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.title: @ mentions: shallow scan + hint in home dir
9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.summary: In the home directory (or an ancestor), @ mentions now do a shallow scan up to 3 levels deep instead of disabling the file tree. A footer hint appears in the mention menu explaining the depth limit. SuggestionMenu gained a `footer` prop.

0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.title: Better fetch idle timeout error messages
0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.summary: Detects Bun's 5-minute fetch inactivity timeout. Shows clear user-facing explanation instead of raw "operation timed out". Truncates error messages to 5000 chars in SDK database.

6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.title: Handle synchronous spawn errors in CLI launcher
6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.summary: Added try/catch around binary spawn to handle synchronous errors (e.g., Windows antivirus blocks). Refactored error exit logic into helper function.

f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.title: Researcher agent requires reading multiple source pages before answering
f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.summary: Updated researcher agent instructions to enforce iterative research and prevent answering from search snippets alone. The agent must now successfully fetch at least 3 pages via `read_url` (5+ for complex questions) before generating a final answer.

53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.title: Login modal warns when URL wraps, suggests copy
53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.summary: Login modal now detects when the auth URL wraps across multiple terminal lines. Displays warning message advising users to press `c` to copy the full link instead of clicking, which would truncate the URL.

bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.title: CLI v1.0.681
bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.summary: Patch release for `codebuff` CLI. Version bumped to 1.0.681.

5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.title: Freebuff Web geo limits, limited-tier model gating, 'blocked' tier
5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.summary: Added `FreebuffWebAccessTier` with 'blocked' state for Tor/anonymous networks. Introduced web-specific limited session pool (5 sessions, 1h), geo-exempt model list (DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5), and helper functions to resolve allowed models for limited-tier users.

f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.title: SSRF protection for readUrl tool
f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.summary: Added SSRF validation to `readUrl` to block requests to private/reserved IPs. Implemented manual redirect following to ensure all hops are validated.

c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.title: Add base-chat agent definition
c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.summary: New internal file `agents/base-chat.ts` defines the 'base-chat' agent for freebuff.com/chat. It uses DeepSeek V4 Flash, has no tools or filesystem access, and includes specific system prompts for web chat interaction.

6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.title: base-chat switched to Fireworks DeepSeek V4 Flash
6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.summary: The `base-chat` agent definition now uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_FIREWORKS_MODEL_ID` (`fireworks/deepseek-v4-flash`) instead of the direct DeepSeek API model. This change applies only to freebuff.com/chat, prioritizing faster inference over slight capability differences. CLI and web builder agents remain unaffected.

38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.title: Chat gains live web search via researcher-web agent
38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.summary: Freebuff Chat can now spawn the `researcher-web` agent to look up current information on the live internet. The agent's display name was updated to 'Web Researcher'.

937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.title: Add Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8; update base2 model routing
937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.summary: New Anthropic models `claude-fable-5` and `claude-opus-4.8` added to type definitions and OpenRouter mapping. Base2 agent now routes `isMax` to `claude-fable-5` and standard paid mode to `claude-opus-4.8`.

e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.title: Fix Bedrock prefill errors; clean eval artifacts
e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.summary: Added `supportsAssistantPrefill` to disable assistant prefill for Claude 4.6+, preventing Bedrock errors. Removed `*-error-*.json` eval dumps and updated `.gitignore`.

a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.title: Add Claude Fable 5 model. Update Opus to 4.8.
a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.summary: Introduced `anthropic/claude-fable-5` as a new model option for best-of-n editors and selectors. Updated `anthropic/claude-opus-4.7` references to `anthropic/claude-opus-4.8` across agent configurations.

7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.title: Waiting room limited-mode notice reworded
7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.summary: Limited-mode text now frames reduced model availability as a neutral notice instead of a bold "Limited mode" label. VPN users get a direct-connection prompt. Session label adjusts to "sessions" for limited tier.

7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.title: Default model switched to MiniMax M3
7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.summary: New users now default to MiniMax M3 instead of Kimi. This provides stronger, multimodal capabilities without consuming daily premium quotas.

66b39f9ac99af7faa8b610590717bdfa5daeb7f1.title: Reduce log bloat, add opt-in trace writer
66b39f9ac99af7faa8b610590717bdfa5daeb7f1.summary: Fixed excessive disk usage by logging only run config summaries. Added automatic cleanup for old oversized logs. Introduced opt-in `trace.jsonl` writer for detailed agent debugging.

409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.title: CLI clipboard fallback for blocked OSC 52 terminals
409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.summary: Added detection for GitHub Codespaces and VS Code remote terminals that silently drop OSC 52 sequences. When copy is blocked, the CLI now displays Shift+drag selection guidance with extended duration.

5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.title: Improve CLI rate limit error messages with upstream details
5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.summary: CLI now displays specific server-side details alongside the standard rate limit message for non-free-mode 429 errors. Error parsing updated to extract messages and codes from nested OpenAI-style error objects.

241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.title: Fix Alt+Enter submit on Kitty protocol keyboards
241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.summary: CLI multiline input now correctly distinguishes plain Enter from Alt+Enter when using Kitty keyboard protocol, preventing accidental message submission.

44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.title: Add MiniMax M3 code reviewer agent
44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.summary: New `code-reviewer-minimax-m3` agent registered for free mode. Removed `noReview` flag from `base2-free-minimax-m3` orchestrator.

f219b409368e128adf95153f694aabf896189c0e.title: Default model switched to Kimi
f219b409368e128adf95153f694aabf896189c0e.summary: Changed the default AI model to Kimi. Fallback remains separate.

209f11b0fb3bcd73c25e68d691e48144f7cc001d.title: Chat ads show single banner instead of choice grid
209f11b0fb3bcd73c25e68d691e48144f7cc001d.summary: Chat surface now renders exactly one full-width ad (`SingleAdBanner`) instead of the multi-ad choice grid. Waiting room still uses `ChoiceAdBanner`.

3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.title: CLI: Display remaining session quota instead of used
3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.summary: Updated the active session summary to show remaining quota units rather than used units. This clarifies how many sessions are left to start. Also standardized the session label to 'premium sessions' in the waiting room.

293172345e45adda8b4ab9be0546a1b5614ad09c.title: CLI session summary now shows used quota instead of remaining
293172345e45adda8b4ab9be0546a1b5614ad09c.summary: Updated active session summary to display total used units rather than remaining, aligning with other status screens. Version bumped to 0.0.104.

38401ec1b8df4542b80b71d41256a043e08f29be.title: MiniMax M3 now free; M2.7 removed from pickers
38401ec1b8df4542b80b71d41256a043e08f29be.summary: MiniMax M3 moved from premium to free tier. MiniMax M2.7 removed from model pickers (legacy support retained).

f34d91198316b40f048582b71a9aa915bac94a52.title: Refactor compileToolDefinitions to accept explicit tool list
f34d91198316b40f048582b71a9aa915bac94a52.summary: Internal refactor of `compileToolDefinitions`. Function now accepts optional `ToolSchemaEntry[]` argument, defaulting to published tools. Enables testing specific schema subsets without changing production behavior.

2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.title: MiniMax M3 training data warning & list reorder
2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.summary: Added 'Collects data for training' warning to MiniMax M3 model constant. Reordered MiniMax M3 in supported models list.

89ef2b771d74e90e173c03c80e5a0b7e1285932f.title: UI button redesign, verb-first tool labels, Kimi/MiniMax multimodal
89ef2b771d74e90e173c03c80e5a0b7e1285932f.summary: Rendered UI buttons now use accent-colored outlines with a trailing arrow instead of solid fills. Gravity index tool calls display verb-first labels like "Search services". Kimi and MiniMax M3 models are marked multimodal.

fe118aa3f6950ee3cc04197a155e65dc87a57339.title: Default model switched to DeepSeek V4 Pro
fe118aa3f6950ee3cc04197a155e65dc87a57339.summary: The default AI model for Freebuff has been updated from `DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH` to `DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO`. This change affects auto-resolution when no specific model is requested.

e39f9da8bc239a0b8c08ee3014e7ec7c2a287c41.title: Added MiniMax M3 model to Freebuff
e39f9da8bc239a0b8c08ee3014e7ec7c2a287c41.summary: Added support for MiniMax M3 as a new premium model option. Introduced the 'Buffy the MiniMax M3 Free Orchestrator' agent.

270a776296bc67ae0369762cf91bc6b047ec9f69.title: Add premium and multimodal flags to model definitions
270a776296bc67ae0369762cf91bc6b047ec9f69.summary: Extended `FreebuffModelOption` with `premium` and `multimodal` booleans. Added `FREEBUFF_MULTIMODAL_MODEL_IDS` and `isFreebuffMultimodalModelId` helper to track image-capable models.

9e59dcc4f5df63719dff99e9e4ec1db6abcb1fbb.title: Fix Enter key handling in CLI, sanitize lone surrogates
9e59dcc4f5df63719dff99e9e4ec1db6abcb1fbb.summary: Updated CLI components to use a shared `isPlainEnterKey` detector, resolving issues with keypad Enter and specific Linux terminals sending linefeed. Added logic to `common/src/util/messages.ts` to replace lone UTF-16 surrogates with U+FFFD, preventing fatal API request failures from malformed text.

bc2e521ae7126000175fdb40f34658c9a358d7ff.title: noReview option added, CLI 0.0.103, schema fix
bc2e521ae7126000175fdb40f34658c9a358d7ff.summary: Added `noReview` flag to `createBase2` to disable free code reviewer agent spawning. Bumped `freebuff` CLI to version 0.0.103. Added `inlineLocalSchemaRefs` to resolve JSON `$ref` in `openai-compatible` tool parameters. SDK now re-throws `CodebuffRunPausedError` instead of swallowing it.

360988f0ed5f75d567ab892ee251a9fa0fcde802.title: gravity_index: CLI UI subcommand labels, base2 research directive, flat params
360988f0ed5f75d567ab892ee251a9fa0fcde802.summary: gravity_index tool display changed to `Services · <Verb>` format in CLI. base2 agent now instructed to use gravity_index before recommending third-party services. `GravityIndexParams` type flattened from discriminated union to single interface with optional fields.

ce77a82c508d26c25c88f298f9d65f4ff224125f.title: Base2 agent: suggest_followups always on, skill prompt removed
ce77a82c508d26c25c88f298f9d65f4ff224125f.summary: Removed isFast gate on suggest_followups tool and followup prompt. Dropped skill loading instruction from implementation step prompt.

4642c507f8c5fe9034ddd46a98554ba964cb16db.title: Gravity Index tool updates: tracked setup links, runtime attribution, install steps
4642c507f8c5fe9034ddd46a98554ba964cb16db.summary: Gravity Index search results now include `credential_request.setup_url` and `click_url` for tracked setup links, replacing the previous `conversion_url`. The tool schema adds `external_session_id` and `metadata` fields for runtime attribution, and agent guidance now directs execution of `install.steps` locally before pausing for credentials.

61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.title: CLI v1.0.680: Add Base2/Mimo Agents, Remove Legacy CLI Agents
61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.summary: Released CLI v1.0.680. Added new Base2 and Mimo agent definitions (including `base2-free-mimo-pro.ts`, `base2-free-mimo.ts`, `base2-mimo.ts`, `code-reviewer-mimo-pro.ts`). Removed legacy CLI agent definitions (`.agents/claude-code-cli.ts`, `.agents/codebuff-local-cli.ts`, `.agents/codex-cli.ts`, `.agents/constants.ts`). Renamed 1 file.

a7e0fa38f02a212b5209e1dfcd97f866d9cba34e.title: MiMo 2.5 Pro tagline
a7e0fa38f02a212b5209e1dfcd97f866d9cba34e.summary: Tagline for MiMo 2.5 Pro changed from 'Smartest & Slower' to 'Smartest & Slow'.

a6571b01b1383c6806b1344375d38525846701ac.title: Cloud 移除 Beta 标记，新增 Enterprise 产品
a6571b01b1383c6806b1344375d38525846701ac.summary: README 中 Freebuff Cloud 不再标记为 Beta。新增 Freebuff Enterprise 产品线及落地页链接。代码层新增 `FREEBUFF_ENTERPRISE_CONTACT_SUBMITTED` 分析事件，用于追踪企业表单提交。

175191e4366e34542cfe2d7dfdd9162faf7c2361.title: Remove Freebuff Enterprise from README
175191e4366e34542cfe2d7dfdd9162faf7c2361.summary: Removed the Freebuff Enterprise row from the product table in both English and Simplified Chinese README files.

bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash removed from free model picker
bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash withdrawn from free model picker due to reliability and speed issues. Removed from README.md, README.zh-CN.md, freebuff-models.ts, and CLI release README.

654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.title: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in free model picker
654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.summary: The free model catalog now offers Muse Spark 1.2 instead of Muse Spark 1.3. This change updates the model selection constants and documentation across the core and CLI packages.

d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.title: Add Muse Spark 1.3 to CLI and Desktop model catalogs
d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 is now available in the free model picker for CLI and Desktop, alongside Web and Cloud. New agent definitions (base2, base3, reviewer) and catalog constants were added to support this model, which uses a shared rate-limit bucket and falls back to DeepSeek V4 Flash when busy.

9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.title: Add Solar Pro 4 to free model picker
9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.summary: Added Solar Pro 4 to the free model catalog in agents/base2, agents/base3, and agents/reviewer. Updated common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and free-agents.ts to register the new model and agents. Documentation in README.md and freebuff/cli/release/README.md reflects the addition.

26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.title: Muse Spark 1.3 replaces 1.2 in free model picker
26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 restored and replaces Muse Spark 1.2 in the free model catalog. 1.2 marked superseded with migration notice. README, free-agents.ts, freebuff-models.ts, CLI release README updated.

92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.title: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces Muse Spark 1.3 in free model picker
92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 withdrawn from catalog due to 404 errors at Meta; Muse Spark 1.2 restored as active free model. New agent definitions added for base2, base3, and code-reviewer roles targeting Muse Spark 1.2. Documentation updated to reflect model swap.

0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces V4 Flash in model catalog
0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.summary: Updated model catalog to replace DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash across CLI selector, shared constants, and documentation. Enabled native multimodal support for the new model version and introduced server-driven upgrade offers for limited accounts.

8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.title: Remove Ox Alpha from free model catalog
8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.summary: Ox Alpha is withdrawn from the free model picker across all interfaces. Documentation and constants in README files, free-agents.ts, and freebuff-models.ts are updated to reflect the removal and pause the model ID for existing sessions.

4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.title: Add Gemini 3.8 Flash to Freebuff Model Catalog

98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.title: New dashboard command shows usage stats
98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.summary: Type /dashboard to open your account dashboard in the browser. This view shows your usage, streak, and activity history. No setup needed: the command works immediately.

2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.title: Help pages explain new auto-checks for web builder
2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.summary: Help pages now explain new auto-checks for the web builder. These checks ensure the builder works correctly before it goes live, catching issues like wrong software versions or broken connections. No action needed from you.

dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.error: LLM summary sentence 1 not plain: "You can now type /diagnostics in the command line to see a snapshot of the app's"

72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.title: Cost reports now track hourly data
72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.summary: Cost reports now track hourly data instead of just full days. This change improves how recent usage is measured for paid subscribers. No action needed.

cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.title: Removed ChatGPT connect command from command line
cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.summary: The /connect command is gone from the command line interface. Users no longer need to link a ChatGPT account to use Freebuff, simplifying the setup process. If you previously used /connect, simply type your request directly; the agent now handles reasoning internally without external account dependencies. This change affects the command line, built-in helpers, and installation packages.

a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.title: Solar Pro 4 metering changes
a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.summary: Solar Pro 4 switches from free to metered billing. The upstream discount expired, so usage is now charged. No action needed; the change applies automatically. The update affects the shared model configuration and pricing constants.

0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.title: Freebuff command line fixes rare startup crash
0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.summary: Freebuff command line no longer crashes when starting without a project folder. It now safely skips path calculations if the project root is missing. Nothing to do: just update Freebuff. The fix touches the command line's internal path helper logic.

abd23ca628058b352e08b9fc4028f775b2c72042.title: Command line tool updated to version 0.0.174
abd23ca628058b352e08b9fc4028f775b2c72042.summary: The command line tool received a small update to version 0.0.174. This change only updates the version number in the release files. No user-visible features or fixes are included. Nothing to do: the update happens automatically when you install or update the tool.

4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.title: Secure secret handling for automated tests
4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.summary: Automated checks now hide secret keys from project files. Keys go to a locked, separate temp folder. No action needed: your saved settings stay safe.

c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaced by DeepSeek V4 Pro in free picker
c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 is gone from the free model picker, replaced by DeepSeek V4 Pro. This swap happened because the old variant was paused and the new one shares the same underlying model, simplifying the selection. Nothing to do: saved choices carry over automatically. The change covers Web, the desktop app, and the command line; V4 Pro remains the deep reasoning pick.

3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.title: Help pages add guide for checking production runtime issues
3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.summary: Help pages now explain how to catch bugs that only happen in the live website environment. This change documents a new automated check that runs the real website on a specific server setup to ensure key features work before release. No action needed for users; this is for developers. The update covers the testing documentation and describes a command line script for running these checks locally.

dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.title: AI now describes images instead of seeing garbled text
dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.summary: Freebuff AI can now properly view and describe image files in your project. Previously, asking about a picture resulted in confusing text errors because the system read raw file data as words. No action needed: just ask about an image file. The update affects the file reading tool in the SDK and agent runtime, allowing supported formats to be sent as visual data.

bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash removed from free model picker
bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash withdrawn from `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and added to `FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Removal driven by reliability and speed failures (7x slower turns, 25% mid-stream errors) despite routing fixes. Row retained in `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS` to ensure backward compatibility for installed binaries. Updated in `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`, and `freebuff/cli/release/README.md`.

4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash added to free model picker
4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash added to free model picker via `FREEBUFF_GEMINI_38_FLASH_MODEL_ID`. Requires dedicated base2/base3 roots and reviewer agent to prevent fallback to unauthorized DeepSeek Flash reviewer. Covers Web, CLI, Desktop, and docs; uses OpenRouter flex tier with strict price ceiling.

26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.title: Muse Spark 1.3 replaces 1.2 in free model picker
26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 re-enters the free model catalog, replacing 1.2 in FREEBUFF_MODELS and the CLI picker. 1.3 was previously withdrawn on 2026-09-07 due to upstream 404 model_not_found errors, but is restored on 2026-09-13. 1.2 is retired from the picker via FREEBUFF_WEB_RETIRED_PICKER_MODEL_IDS but remains in SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS to serve existing sessions and installed CLI/Desktop builds. Saved 1.2 preferences migrate to 1.3 via migrateSupersededFreebuffModelPreference.

d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.title: Muse Spark 1.3 added to CLI and Desktop free model picker
d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor tier added to CLI and Desktop catalogs via `agents/base3-free-muse-spark-1-3.ts` and `agents/base2/base2-free-muse-spark-1-3.ts`. Previously Web/Cloud only, it now ships everywhere after the key pool expanded capacity to 600 RPM across four teams, allowing the server to silently fallback to DeepSeek V4 Flash on saturation without client-side wait UIs. Scope covers `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` catalog definitions, `free-agents.ts` allowlists, `freebuff-desktop-sessions.ts` concurrency limits, and README tables. Both new roots set `noReview` to prevent doubling request rates against Meta's team-metered ceilings; a dedicated reviewer agent (`code-reviewer-muse-spark-1-3.ts`) is registered but unspawned to block base2 rollbacks from falling through to the Flash reviewer and 403ing.

9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.title: Solar Pro 4 added to free model picker
9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.summary: Solar Pro 4 (`upstage/solar-pro4`) joins the free model catalog as a limited-time trial. Served via OpenRouter with BYOK Upstage keys, it carries a 524K context window (conservatively set to 500K internally) and text-only support. The `upstage/zdr` tag ensures zero data retention, bypassing training notices. Registered across Web, CLI, and Desktop surfaces via new agent definitions and `FREEBUFF_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOWS`.

8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.title: Ox Alpha withdrawn from free model picker
8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.summary: Ox Alpha removed from free model picker after host ended zero-cost promotion on 2026-08-27. Model ID paused in FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS rather than deleted, preserving root agent base2-free-ox-alpha and allowlist entries to prevent mid-session 403s or free_mode_invalid_agent_model errors for live sessions. Covers README.md, README.zh-CN.md, common/src/constants/free-agents.ts, common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts, and freebuff/cli/release/README.md. MiMo 2.5 is now sole unmetered model; row remains in SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS so released CLI/Desktop binaries coerce instead of refuse.

0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces V4 Flash 07/31 in model catalog
0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 in the free model picker. The undated `deepseek-v4-flash` wire ID now resolves to V4.1, which is natively multimodal, prompting `multimodal: true` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and a display name change to drop the build date suffix. Covers CLI, Web, and Desktop via `FREEBUFF_MODELS`, `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, and README tables. The `compactChatModelName` and `shortModelName` helpers no longer strip a trailing date from this row, as the new name lacks one.

68b487b1f0fc0e9fd42f83503efa2533890ff411.title: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro in free model picker
68b487b1f0fc0e9fd42f83503efa2533890ff411.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro as the deep-reasoning model. Served via OpenRouter with id `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`, it falls through to the default route. Capped at 2 sessions/day during cost measurement. Covers Web, CLI, Desktop via `FREEBUFF_GLM_V53_FLASH_MODEL_ID` and `FREEBUFF_GLM_V53_FLASH_MAX_PRICE`.

f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.title: Ox Alpha added to free model picker
f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.summary: Ox Alpha joins CLI and Desktop catalogs via `base3-free-ox-alpha.ts` and `code-reviewer-ox-alpha.ts`. Required to prevent base2 sessions falling back to DeepSeek Flash reviewer, which fails allowlist checks mid-run. Limited tier access added to `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS`; metered by region not model, so no extra pool cost. Removed from explicit `FREEBUFF_WEB_MODELS` list to prevent duplicate entries in browser pickers.

358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.title: CLI 1.0.688
358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.summary: Version bump to 1.0.688. Changes `codebuff` package version in `cli/release/package.json`. Internal release only.

92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.title: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in free model picker
92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.summary: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in the free model picker after 1.3 began returning upstream 404 model_not_found errors on all keys. Saved 1.2 preferences migrate to 1.3 on load; existing live sessions keep running. Covers Web, CLI, and Desktop via FREEBUFF_MODELS plus README tables; 1.2 keeps its fast all-round row.

9d2ffeb174143be273cd3257275edcf79094c33f.title: Model catalog adds DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-5.6
9d2ffeb174143be273cd3257275edcf79094c33f.summary: Five new models added to the free model picker: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiniMax M3, MiMo 2.5. README.md and README.zh-CN.md restructured to present Freebuff as five distinct products (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat) rather than Codebuff's free tier. The catalog is curated and ad-supported. Documentation covers both English and Chinese surfaces.

77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.title: CLI release 1.0.686
77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.summary: Version bump for codebuff CLI to 1.0.686 and freebuff CLI to 0.0.162. Updates package.json metadata for both distribution channels. No functional code changes included in this release.

cbdf5030d0238565dfe2852e8eacc93bfc803b82.title: MiniMax M3 withdrawn from free model picker
cbdf5030d0238565dfe2852e8eacc93bfc803b82.summary: MiniMax M3 removed from FREEBUFF_MODELS and picker UIs. Added model_unavailable gate (410, endsTheSession: false) to handle withdrawn requests without ending sessions. Kept M3 in SUPPORTED and allowlist to prevent mid-turn failures for live sessions. Updated READMEs and tier change notices to reflect removal.

477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaces V4 Pro in model picker
477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaces the undated V4 Pro in the free model picker. The undated label obscured the GA build's distinct behavior, and the 08/13 version now supports the full low/high/max reasoning ladder, matching Flash. This change updates `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, `README.md`, and CLI selectors. Flash remains the default model, as Pro consumes more resources and draws from the premium pool.

c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaces V4 Pro 08/13 in free model catalog
c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 as the default full-access model. The 08/13 variant was paused, forcing a fallback to the base V4 Pro which is now also the planner target. Both Web and CLI surfaces updated to reflect this change in READMEs and constants. Planner logic in `free-agents.ts` now routes both tiers to the primary agent ID since model variants converged.

654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.title: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in free model picker
654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.summary: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces Muse Spark 1.3 in the free model picker after 1.3's restoration proved unstable. Saved 1.2 preferences no longer auto-migrate to 1.3; the `supersededBy` block is removed from `MUSE_SPARK_12_CONTRIBUTOR_MODEL`. Covers Web, CLI, and Desktop via `FREEBUFF_MODELS` plus README tables; 1.2 remains last in list to preserve queue accounting.

bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.title: CLI 1.0.682 adds onboarding suggested prompts
bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.summary: CLI 1.0.682 introduces `SuggestedPrompts` component for first-time Freebuff users. New settings flag `hasSubmittedFirstPrompt` gates visibility, retiring prompts after any submission. Hover reveals full prompt text when terminal width permits. Adds `SUGGESTED_PROMPT_SHOWN` and `SUGGESTED_PROMPT_CLICKED` analytics events.

6e392721fb79228f970577ee7d957562e282073f.title: CLI release 1.0.683
6e392721fb79228f970577ee7d957562e282073f.summary: Version bumped to 1.0.683 in cli/release/package.json. No functional changes.

ed26dd9b5f6f9727085a011414d3e8ceb738118f.title: CLI release 1.0.685
ed26dd9b5f6f9727085a011414d3e8ceb738118f.summary: Version bump to 1.0.685 in cli/release/package.json. Routine release increment.

c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.title: CLI 1.0.684 adds legacy Gemini model ID constant
c8464c6866193ec4780e23b225ab06252eee2ffc.summary: CLI release 1.0.684 published. common/src/constants/gemini.ts adds LEGACY_GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_LITE_PREVIEW_MODEL_ID for google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview. Covers codebuff 1.0.683 to 1.0.684 and freebuff 0.0.120 to 0.0.121.

bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.title: CLI 1.0.681
bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.summary: CLI release 1.0.681 published. Version bump in cli/release/package.json. Scope limited to CLI package.

61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.title: Freebuff CLI 1.0.680 adds MiMo models, drops legacy CLI agents
61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.summary: Version 1.0.680 introduces MiMo-based agents in `agents/base2/` and `agents/reviewer/`, replacing deleted legacy CLI wrappers like `claude-code-cli.ts` and `codex-cli.ts`. The removal of `.agents/` directory files and `constants.ts` signifies a shift away from external CLI orchestration towards native agent definitions. Core updates include new streak query hooks in `cli/src/hooks/` and type adjustments in `common/src/types/freebuff-streak.ts`. This release requires no manual migration for users, as the new agents are auto-registered via `agents/types/agent-definition.ts`.

98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.title: Add /dashboard command for account hub
98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.summary: Added `/dashboard` slash command to CLI, opening the Freebuff account hub in the browser. The command aggregates usage, streak, and session data, leveraging new shared types in `common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts` and utility functions in `common/src/util/freebuff-usage-summary.ts`. It is registered as a Freebuff-only command, distinct from Codebuff's `/usage`. The implementation includes constants for usage map history (`FREEBUFF_USAGE_MAP_DAYS`) and recent token lookback (`FREEBUFF_RECENT_TOKENS_DAYS`), with the command handler using `safeOpen` to handle headless environments gracefully.

ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.title: /copy exports full conversation to clipboard
ce02985fc2dae21a5d6635d933952781273e3b33.summary: New `/copy` slash command serializes the full conversation (messages, reasoning, tool calls, sub-agents) into Markdown and writes to clipboard. Aliases `copy-chat` and `export` registered in `command-registry.ts`. SSH sessions hit OSC 52's ~24KB raw-text ceiling, so the command progressively drops largest tool results (then inputs) with omission notes until it fits; local sessions use `pbcopy`/`xclip` and always copy the full transcript. `keepTailBytes` cuts on UTF-8 codepoint boundaries as last-resort fallback, and JSON tool result envelopes are pretty-printed for readability.

b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.title: Refactor CLI slash command suggestion engine
b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.summary: Refactored filterSlashCommands in use-suggestion-engine.ts by extracting shared id/alias prefix and substring matching logic into a helper function. Exported filterSlashCommands for direct testing. Maintains existing behavior for command discovery and highlighting.

217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.title: Add auto top-up link to CLI rate limit message
217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.summary: Rate limit message in `freebuff-landing-screen.tsx` now includes link to `https://freebuff.com/freebucks` for auto top-up. Helps users avoid session exit on quota exhaustion by enabling continuous usage. Scope limited to CLI landing screen component.

175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.title: Add /byok command for bring-your-own-key provider configuration
175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.summary: New `/byok` slash command enables direct provider account usage via environment variable keys. Implementation adds `cli/src/commands/byok.ts` and `cli/src/utils/byok.ts` for state management and validation, alongside `sdk/scripts/qualify-byok-credentials.ts` for worker-side credential checks. The change modifies auth flows in `cli/src/app.tsx` and `cli/src/chat.tsx` to skip Freebuff session polling and disable ads when a BYOK connection is selected. Command history sanitization redacts potential credentials in `/byok add` arguments, and transcript reset logic prevents cross-provider session resumption errors.

cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.title: Remove /connect ChatGPT OAuth flow
cc2e698cf6c70dfad256e440be039d256a163222.summary: Deleted `/connect` slash command and associated ChatGPT OAuth infrastructure. Removed `chatgpt-connect-banner.tsx`, `chatgpt-oauth.ts` utils/constants, and `chatgpt-backend-fetch.ts` from SDK. Base2 agent config dropped `noThinkerGpt` flag; `thinker-gpt` spawn logic now strictly checks `!isFreebuff` instead of custom flag. CLI prompt builders for `/plan` and `/review` simplified to always use selected model, removing conditional GPT delegation logic.

28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.title: New /export command writes full transcript to file
28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.summary: Added `/export` slash command to CLI, replacing the alias previously held by `/copy`. It writes the entire conversation to disk as Markdown by default, or raw JSON if the filename ends in `.json`, bypassing `/copy`'s 32KB clipboard limit. The command uses async atomic writes to prevent UI blocking and path resolution guards to ensure files stay within the project root. Existing `/copy` aliases were cleaned up to remove the conflicting `export` alias.

2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.title: Add prod-smoke docs for freebuff-web builder app
2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.summary: docs/testing.md documents the `build-freebuff-web` CI job's prod-smoke gate, mirroring the existing `web` smoke. The harness (`packages/internal/src/prod-smoke/harness.ts`) enforces loopback-only DB access, Bun-shim refusal, and seeded fixtures, while `upstream-stub.cjs` mocks external calls. This covers the auto-deploying `freebuff-web` service, which requires a specific Node version pin (`.node-version`) and tests an in-process agent journey via `@codebuff/sdk`.

a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.title: Solar Pro 4 promo ends 2026-09-13, metered pricing resumes
a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.summary: The `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES` array in `common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts` adds a new entry effective `2026-09-13T05:00:00Z` that reverts `FREEBUFF_SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL_ID` to `SOLAR_REGULAR_OFFER`. This ends the 0 Freebucks promo window, restoring metered pricing as servers deploy the change. The OpenRouter lane in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` now documents the 90% Upstage discount as a persistent key rate rather than a time-boxed launch promo, removing expiry logic from `web/src/llm-api/openrouter-price-overrides.ts` while the discount holds.

3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.title: Document production-runtime smoke in build-web
3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.summary: Added section explaining `build-web` Node runtime smoke test. Documents `Promise.withResolvers` production failure (#3218) and `prod-smoke.ts` mechanism. Scope limited to `docs/testing.md`. Details local execution command requiring loopback Postgres.

73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.title: /reasoning slash command added to CLI
73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.summary: New `/reasoning` slash command allows setting the thinking effort level for the selected Freebuff model. It validates against the local catalog and applies changes to subsequent requests via `codebuff_metadata`. The command is restricted to Freebuff mode; on Codebuff, values are silently dropped. Updates include state management in `freebuff-model-store.ts` and UI reflection in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`.

51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.title: SubscriptionCostMetrics interface added to common types
51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.summary: New `SubscriptionCostMetrics` and `SubscriptionCostReport` interfaces defined in `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts`. These types structure cost data for paid subscribers, including total provider cost, subscription-funded portions, and unattributed costs. The `SubscriptionCostReport` interface supports a fixed 30-day forecast horizon with tier-based estimation for newer users. Fields like `attributionComplete` flag missing funding attribution within the reporting window.

3dc7ec2306d94243ab2ba83ab457b59bcd4713c1.title: /queue panel edits, reorders, deletes queued messages
3dc7ec2306d94243ab2ba83ab457b59bcd4713c1.summary: New `/queue` command opens `queue-panel.tsx` for editing, reordering, and deleting queued messages. Keyboard `Ctrl+Q` and alias `/queued` trigger the panel; `QueuedMessage` gains stable `id` fields for identity-based addressing. Store persists across sessions; panel auto-closes on empty queue or review/ask_user takeover. No `/q` alias to avoid accidental CLI exit.

72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.title: SubscriptionCostReport adds observedHours and forecast window fields
72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.summary: SubscriptionCostReport in common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts adds optional observedHours, forecastObservationStart, and forecastObservationEnd fields. The doc comment shifts from a fully covered UTC-day report to a recent completed-hour report, separating measured hours from the complete-day forecast basis. Scope limited to Shared/Core types. observedHours includes partial UTC days.

0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.title: Fix uncaught throw in CLI getRelativePath
0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.summary: CLI path helper `getRelativePath` now calls `tryGetProjectRoot` instead of `getProjectRoot`. This prevents uncaught exceptions when the project root is unset, such as during early startup or in test environments. The fallback logic remains reachable, returning the absolute path unchanged when no root is detected. Affects `cli/src/utils/path-helpers.ts`.

dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.title: /diagnostics command added, Windows process tree kill fix
dc18d1a2063a92cc1939648a0280c0847a662c73.summary: New `/diagnostics` slash command exposes local CLI resource usage and active terminal tool PIDs. Windows process termination switched to `taskkill.exe` to prevent orphaned grandchildren when killing Git Bash wrappers. SDK exports `getActiveTerminalCommandProcesses` for safe PID reporting without secrets. Focus state resets in chat store were removed to prevent animation glitches on unfocused terminals.

4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.title: e2e session env sourcing
4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.summary: FreebuffSession.create now accepts an env option, writing exports to a 0600 env.sh file outside the workDir. The tmux command sources this file before launching the binary, keeping secrets out of indexed directories and recorded command lines. Cleanup logic in stop() removes both workDir and envDir. See freebuff/e2e/utils/freebuff-session.ts.
